jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Cloud and Connectors
jobs.loc: Flexible / Remote, Salt Lake City, UT
jobs.desc:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

About DX

DX is the developer intelligence platform. We help engineering leaders understand how work gets done, improve developer experience, and make better decisions about productivity and AI. DX combines self-reported insights from developers with data from the systems where software work happens, then turns those signals into insights teams can act on.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead DX's data platform and connector portfolio.

The data platform is the foundation beneath every DX insight. It connects to the tools our customers use, ingests and organizes their data, protects its integrity, and makes it available to the rest of the DX product. You will own the product direction and outcomes for Data Cloud, our connector ecosystem, core data integrity, and the data infrastructure behind our demo environment.

This is a deeply technical product role. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to reason credibly about connectors, APIs, data models, database design, data lakes, reliability, enterprise data requirements, and data privacy/security. You will turn that understanding into a data platform that customers and internal product teams can trust.

What you'll do

  • Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for DX's Data Cloud and connector ecosystem.
  • Prioritize connector investments using customer demand, market context, strategic leverage, and the needs of downstream DX products.
  • Improve the end-to-end connector experience, including setup, authentication, configuration, data mapping, sync health, and troubleshooting.
  • Define product requirements for data quality, freshness, completeness, reliability, and transparency.
  • Partner closely with Engineering on the evolution of DX's unified data layer while maintaining a clear boundary between product direction and technical design.
  • Own the product capabilities that keep DX's demo environment representative, reliable, and useful.
  • Build a deep understanding of enterprise data environments, security constraints, integration patterns, and the teams responsible for them.
  • Shape ambiguous opportunities with lightweight specs, prototypes, and clear written context before the team commits to a solution.
  • Know how the platform is performing across connector adoption, time to value, reliability, and customer satisfaction; investigate problems and drive the right improvements.
  • Partner with customer-facing and go-to-market teams on connector discovery, pilots, launches, documentation, and positioning.

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Zone B: $151,470 - $197,753

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Originations & Growth
jobs.desc:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

About The Role 

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead and evolve Koalafi’s Originations product and drive growth across our end-to-end apply & checkout experiences. that serve as the front door to financing for every customer. This is a high-impact role at the center of Koalafi’s strategy to accelerate growth by making it easier, faster, and more intuitive for consumers to finance their purchases across both online and in-store channels.  

This role is ideal for a product manager who thrives working at the intersection of strategy, execution, and deep cross-functional collaboration. You’ll set the direction for Originations by aligning diverse partners, from Risk and Compliance to Marketing and Sales, around a cohesive strategy that accelerates growth while maintaining a unified vision. 

What You’ll Do 

Define and drive the Originations roadmap 

  • Lead product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Originations product as an engine for growth
  • Develop the product strategy for apply & checkout flows that are reusable across diverse merchant and consumer contexts – such as a consumer’s mobile phone to a store owner’s point-of-sale system or e-commerce checkout integration 

Grow and optimize the Originations funnel 

  • Drive continuous funnel optimization by identifying conversion opportunities using quantitative data and qualitative insights to ship rapid improvements while balancing profitability and compliance
  • Grow Koalafi’s distribution across channels by partnering with cross-functional teams to design and ship frictionless experiences that work for both merchants and consumers 

Shape the product for rapid insight generation and experimentation 

  • Partner with analytics and engineering to instrument the funnel, generate actionable insights, and run A/B tests to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes
  • Mentor other PMs and establish best practices for experimentation and funnel analysis across the broader organization 

Champion the customer experience 

  • Champion the customer, bringing curiosity and empathy to every decision to ensure the application experience meets real customer needs
  • Conduct user research and map consumer and merchant journeys to uncover usability gaps and unmet needs

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (CMK/Encryption Platform)
jobs.desc:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian is looking for a product leader to own the strategy, delivery, and operating model for our Customer Managed Keys (CMK) and encryption platform portfolio. This role will lead a high-impact area at the intersection of enterprise trust, platform capability, regulatory readiness, and customer value. The Product Lead will define how encryption capabilities scale across Atlassian Cloud, clarify product and platform scope, and drive outcomes across CMK, encryption platform, bring-your-own-key patterns, and adjacent encryption services.

The CMK/Encryption Platform Product Lead is responsible for product strategy, roadmap definition, and cross-functional execution for Atlassian's encryption platform work. The role spans both customer-facing capabilities and foundational platform services, requiring strong judgment on where to standardize, where to differentiate, and how to sequence investments across security, scale, and commercial impact.

This leader will work across product, engineering, security, go-to-market, legal, compliance, and customer-facing teams to ensure Atlassian's encryption capabilities meet enterprise expectations while remaining durable, usable, and economically sound.

The team's scope includes:

  • Customer Managed Keys strategy, roadmap, packaging, and lifecycle
  • Cryptor and related encryption platform capabilities used across Atlassian Cloud
  • Bring Your Own Key and external key management patterns, including future-facing options where relevant
  • Encryption standards, architecture direction, and platform consistency across products and cells
  • Enterprise customer requirements related to trust, control, compliance, and key management
  • Prioritization of investments that balance customer demand, risk reduction, platform leverage, and revenue influence

What you'll do

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for CMK and encryption platform capabilities across Atlassian Cloud
  • Clarify product scope and platform boundaries across CMK, Encryption Platfrom, and adjacent encryption services so teams can execute with clear accountability
  • Drive roadmap decisions across customer commitments, enterprise needs, architecture constraints, and commercial priorities
  • Partner closely with engineering and security leaders on encryption architecture, technical direction, delivery sequencing, and operational readiness
  • Lead planning for key initiatives such as CMK expansion, platform standardization, key management evolution, cell-scoped capabilities, and efficiency improvements
  • Represent the product area in executive, cross-functional, and customer settings with clear narrative, strong judgment, and crisp tradeoff framing
  • Work with field, support, and customer-facing teams to understand enterprise demand, shape adoption strategy, and unblock strategic opportunities
  • Ensure roadmap choices reflect security, compliance, resilience, scale, and usability expectations for a critical trust capability
  • Create alignment across product, platform, and go-to-market teams on what is being built, why it matters, and how success will be measured
  • Maintain continuity on in-flight work while improving role clarity, planning quality, and long-term portfolio coherence

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, eCommerce
jobs.desc:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff is building a new e-commerce advertising platform, and we're looking for a Product Manager to own it from zero to one. Today the product drives app users to purchase directly on merchants' e-commerce sites. You'll take the product from its current early state through beta and on the path to general availability, partnering with a dedicated engineering team, our ML organization, and go-to-market teams to set strategy, prioritize the roadmap, and decide what's in and out of scope. This is a senior, largely individual-contributor role with real autonomy: you'll own the business case, the experimentation roadmap, and the platform's identity and attribution architecture, and you'll represent Liftoff directly with customers and partners.

Responsibilities

Own the strategy and the business case

  • Set the product strategy, quarterly goals, and success metrics, and present progress against milestones to executive leadership and finance
  • Own the unit economics that define launch readiness (success metrics, traffic quality, funnel efficiency), and make the call on when the data supports scaling, pivoting, or stopping
  • Decide what stays out of scope. The possible surface area will always exceed team capacity, and disciplined scope-cutting is as important as anything you ship
  • Partner with GTM, sales, and account teams to define ideal customer profiles and go-to-market strategy, select and onboard customers, and turn customer intel into roadmap decisions. Represent Liftoff in customer conversations and strategic industry partnerships

Drive performance through ML partnership

  • Partner with Eng leads to own the experiment roadmap, interpret A/B results, and make Go/No-Go decisions
  • Diagnose full-funnel performance from ad impression through site session, add-to-cart, and purchase, and call out investigation opportunities
  • Set and enforce traffic quality and creative UX standards that protect advertiser outcomes, including suppression logic and inventory quality controls

Own identity, attribution, and platform integrations

  • Work with Legal to define product policy around consent handling, regional privacy requirements, customer data protection, and compliance (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Develop strategic partnership and integration opportunities to ensure robust measurement and attribution
  • Defend our attribution methodology and incrementality story with sophisticated performance marketers and agencies
  • Lead e-commerce platform integration work end to end: pixels, server-side event delivery, order attribution, catalog ingestion, and merchant-facing installation flows

Requirements

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search & Evaluate - StreetEasy

About the team

StreetEasy is the most-used local real estate platform in New York City - the place where millions of buyers and renters begin, conduct, and ultimately make one of the highest-stakes decisions of their lives. Unlike when searching for everyday items, our users aren't just looking for quick, easy results. They're navigating a complex market defined by co-op boards, neighborhood nuance, and inventory that moves fast and unevenly. Search & Evaluate sits at the center of that experience, where users spend the most time and where the most critical intent signals are generated.
This role owns the core shopping experience - search, browse, compare, evaluate - and the data and signals it produces that power personalization, agent matching, and growth across the platform.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior PM who has managed search tools for a marketplace. You understand that searching for a home is a long, thoughtful process, which is very different from searching for simple, everyday products or just browsing general content.You've lived the tension between relevance and monetization, between exploration and conversion, and between what users say they want and what behavioral data tells you they actually do.
This is a pivotal role where you'll elevate the product to the next level. There is massive potential to innovate through AI-assisted discovery, intent-aware personalization, and advanced agentic flows. You'll have the opportunity to define this roadmap and lead the team in building a more personalized decision-making journey for our users.

You Will Get To

  • Define and drive the search and shopping experience across web, iOS, and Android, from initial query through listing and building detail, saving and comparing.
  • Rethink how we personalize the process of finding a home-a high-stakes, infrequent decision. User intent shifts over months, so our sparse signals have to do more heavy lifting than in typical search contexts.
  • Partner with engineering and data science to lead the evolution of our search strategy, prioritizing high-impact AI-native opportunities that will transform how users navigate the market.
  • Own the property evaluation pages and experience, helping users navigate NYC-specific nuances like co-op policies and pricing.
  • Navigate the structural tension between organic relevance and advertising products that are core to the business model - not a side constraint, but a daily design problem.
  • Set the measurement framework for search quality in a non-deterministic, AI-powered experience - defining what "good" looks like when you can't rely on clean A/B tests alone.

Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

An overview of this role

GitLab is building the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform, and this role will help shape how teams move from planning to code in an AI-native software development lifecycle.

As Senior Product Manager, Source Code, you'll shape how planning and managing source code will evolve in an AI-native software development lifecycle. This role is focused on bringing planning and code closer together, so teams can move from requirements and specifications to commits, merge requests, and customer value with speed and quality.

This area is evolving quickly. We're exploring how AI agents can use specifications, context, and human feedback to build the right thing, not just build the thing right. You'll define new product experiences for spec-driven, human-in-the loop development: how the link between planning intent and the code that implements it gets created, stays accurate as both change, and gets used at review time. The hard part is that this link decays. Code moves, specs might not follow, you will define how to make that connection self-maintaining.

This is an ambiguous, high-impact opportunity for a product manager who has strong software development lifecycle knowledge, is comfortable working with technical teams, and wants to help create something new in DevSecOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and drive product strategy for experiences that connect planning, source code management, and AI-assisted development.
  • Shape workflows where teams and agents move between intent and code in both directions, so a specification can be traced to the merges that implement it and a diff can be read and reviewed against the intent behind it.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Professional Experience
jobs.desc:
About ShiftKey

ShiftKey is a platform that is disrupting the way healthcare facilities find licensed and certified professionals to fill available shifts. Leveraging marketplace dynamics and deep industry knowledge, the company is playing a vital role in mitigating America's healthcare staffing shortages, enabling direct connections between facilities and healthcare professionals. By offering the opportunity to work as much or as little as they choose and putting the power back into the hands of healthcare workers, ShiftKey is bringing more licensed professionals back into the workforce, a solution that is solving a major crisis in healthcare. For more information, visit www.ShiftKey.com.

The role

ShiftKey connects healthcare professionals with facilities across diverse care settings, and our professional experience - from the first shift someone picks up to whether they're still picking up shifts three years later - is what keeps that marketplace healthy. Our Product Team operates in an augmented model - you will direct what we are building toward and our non-negotiables, while our delivery partners direct how it gets built.

Professionals who pick up shifts on ShiftKey have options - other platforms, direct facility work, leaving staffing entirely. This role owns the experience that makes ShiftKey the one they stick with: finding shifts, getting placed, seeing what they earn and why, building a reputation, and coming back. You'll own Professional Lifetime Value as the metric that tells you whether it's working, and you'll partner with the PM who owns the facility side to keep the marketplace healthy on both ends.

Where you'll work

This is a fully remote position based in the United States. You should be comfortable working asynchronously and partnering with teammates in different time zones.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the professional's experience end to end: discovery, placement, and what keeps them coming back.
  • Define and own Professional Lifetime Value, reporting on it up to leadership.
  • Build the retention strategy that keeps professionals active for years, not just their first shift.
  • Design how professionals build reputation and get discovered by facilities.
  • Make earnings clear - what they make, why, and how to make it better.

What you'll need

  • 7-9 years in product management, with meaningful time on the supply side of a marketplace or platform.
  • Experience solving for engagement, not just availability, in a marketplace or platform.
  • Comfort connecting product decisions to unit economics and talking through them with finance.
  • Sharp data instincts - you instrument before you build, and can diagnose retention vs. discovery problems.
  • A strong track record partnering across team boundaries you don't fully control.

Perks of working for ShiftKey

  • Inclusive and collaborative work environment where all voices are valued.
  • Hybrid-friendly office spaces designed to be fun and engaging.
  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage.
  • Benefits begin on your first day.
  • Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including flexible floating holidays.
  • 100% 401(k) employer match up to 6%.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Wellness support, including access to mental health resources.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Product Manager at Handoff

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own the roadmap, strategy, and execution of a core product squad. In this role, you’ll lead engineers and designers to ship high-quality, high-impact features that improve contractor workflows, while connecting product decisions to measurable business and growth outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who combines a strong product mindset with customer obsession and a high bar for execution. You should be energized by complexity, detail-oriented, and excited to work in a fast-paced, AI-driven startup solving real-world problems for builders and remodelers.

What you’ll do

  • Own the squad roadmap, strategy, and execution for a core product area.
  • Conduct continuous customer discovery - interviews, prototypes, field visits - and turn insights into clear specs, user stories, and priorities.
  • Partner closely with engineering and design to iterate quickly and deliver intuitive, polished experiences.
  • Define adoption, activation, and retention metrics; set up tracking, analyze performance, and iterate based on data.
  • Produce and update our roadmap and communicate product direction across leadership and GTM teams.
  • Translate features into benefits and customer outcomes, supporting sales, marketing, and onboarding with clear collateral.
  • Sweat the details - QA, polish, and validate every flow and edge case before launch.
  • Apply Handoff’s product principles - simplemaxxing, mobile-first, AI-first, and customer-obsession - to every design, feature, and product decision

About you

  • 3-5+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally in vertical SaaS.
  • Experience building B2B SaaS products; with AI experience strongly preferred.
  • Track record of shipping 0→1 or early-stage features.
  • Strong skills in customer discovery, research, and ruthless prioritization.
  • Proven ability to work hand-in-hand with engineers and designers in agile environments.
  • Excellent writing and communication - able to produce crisp specs, epics, and roadmap docs.
  • Excitement about construction, remodeling, and home services - genuine curiosity about contractors’ world.
  • Bonus experience: CRM, project management tools, payments/fintech, AI-driven products, or PLG (product-led growth).
  • Startup DNA - comfort in ambiguity, bias for action, stamina for fast-moving environments.

What we offer

  • Competitive Salary + Equity
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k)
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Life & Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Dependent Care FSA (DC FSA)
  • Relocation Allowance
  • Top-Notch Equipment
  • Team Offsites

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Kiss My Apps — компанія-платформа, що об’єднує 7 продуктових вертикалей та 30+ AI-first продуктів, 100+ мільйонів користувачів, власну екосистему аналітичних, пеймент та маркетингових розробок.

Продукти KMA це світові лідери в нішах utilities, lifestyle, health&fitness — AI Remodel, Printer, Botan, Calorie Counter і не тільки. Це продукти, що займають топ-1 місця App Store й вирішують потреби комʼюніті з сотень мільйонів людей.

Наш темп — це наш competitive advantage. KMA зростає мінімум х3 рік до року — і ми шукаємо Lead Product Manager, того/ту, хто допоможе масштабуватись ще швидше.

Коротко про роль:

Шукаємо Lead Product Manager, який(а) очолить розвиток одного з наших AI-driven застосунків на ринку, що активно зростає. Це роль із повним ownership за результат продукту — від формування продуктової стратегії до масштабування growth-каналів.

Наші продукти вже мають підтверджений product-market fit і значний потенціал кратного зростання. Твоя задача — знайти та оптимізувати робочу юніт-економіку, вибудувати системний процес продуктових експериментів і масштабувати продукт через продуктову розробку та performance-маркетинг.

Ця роль для людини, яка хоче не просто підтримувати існуючий продукт, а драйвити його масштабування, впливати на ключові метрики бізнесу та будувати продукт із потенціалом стати флагманом у своїй ніші.

Твої задачі:

  • Визначення продуктової та growth-стратегії для масштабування.

  • Пошук і стабілізація юніт-економіки продукту: pricing, paywall, retention, acquisition та ключові продуктові метрики.

  • Побудова системного процесу продуктових експериментів для зростання revenue та масштабування продукту.

  • Управління продуктовою командою та формування чітких цілей розвитку продукту.

  • Тісна робота з маркетингом для масштабування закупки трафіку (Meta, CPA-мережі та інші канали).

  • Прийняття ключових рішень по продукту: стратегія, позиціонування, монетизація, roadmap та розвиток команди.

Що очікуємо від тебе:

  • Досвід роботи з мобільними застосунками та розуміння специфіки mobile-ринку.

  • Практичний досвід масштабування продуктів або запуску нових продуктів з відчутним growth-результатом.

  • Сильна експертиза у продуктовій аналітиці та юніт-економіці.

  • Розуміння performance-маркетингу та досвід роботи з каналами платного трафіку (Meta, CPA networks тощо).

  • Досвід роботи з subscription-моделями монетизації.

Ми точно заметчимось, якщо ти не боїшся приймати сміливі рішення, ризикувати та завжди досягаєш своєї мети.

Ми пропонуємо:

  • Формат роботи на твій вибір: fully remote з будь-якої точки вільного світу, а також доступ до одного з наших офісів за бажанням (Київ, Варшава).

  • Умови, завдяки яким ти можеш сфокусуватись на перформ

jobs.desc:
About Versapay 

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.

Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.

Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.

Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

Kindred is a members-only home swapping platform that unlocks the ability to live a travel-rich lifestyle through the power of community. By exchanging primary residences with trusted peers, renters and owners alike can match with Kindred spirits and explore new destinations without breaking the bank.

Kindred is revolutionizing the “third option” of travel accommodation, compared to short-term rentals and hotels. Since launching in 2022, Kindred has grown to a global community of 300,000 members across 150+ cities and puts home swapping on the map as a radically more affordable, responsible, and connected way to travel.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Cloud Networking
jobs.desc:
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.

One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.

About the Role:

Confluent Cloud delivers a complete end-to-end streaming experience via a Software as a Service (SaaS) model. To deliver a simple, understandable, and scalable product experience requires abstracting the complex interactions of underlying cloud infrastructure, networking, storage, and compute powering a stateful distributed system.

As a Senior Product Manager on the Cloud Networking Product team, you’ll contribute to the mission of making connectivity to and from Confluent Cloud reliable, scalable, secure, cost efficient and simple to use so that users can focus on building streaming applications instead of managing infrastructure. Cloud networking with focus on private networking is an enabler for all services offered on Confluent Cloud and is a strategic investment area for Confluent with the potential to impact the company’s top and bottom lines.

You’ll be responsible for the success of major product initiatives, from initial conception to execution and launch. You’ll become the trusted resource for your product, making sure that the engineering, design, sales, and marketing have what they need to make the right tradeoffs, build the right product, and grow it successfully in the market.

What You Will Do:

  • Understand our users: Conduct interviews and analyze data to define personas, user journeys, and key jobs to be done.

  • Drive crucial aspects of Confluent Cloud Network Roadmap supporting Confluent Cloud services like Kafka, Flink, Connectors, Data Governance, etc with a heavy focus on user experience and cost efficiency.

  • Define flexible interfaces powering API, CLI and Terraform, data models, and processes and launch a variety of new network options and rapidly iterate on existing ones

  • Be responsible for the whole lifecycle: Drive multi-team, cross-functional initiatives from conception through initial delivery and ongoing iteration after launch.

  • Close the loop: Define quantitative and qualitative targets, measure performance against them, share results with stakeholders, and incorporate those learnings into the product.

  • Manage complexity: Deliver value while handling the surprises and challenges of a quickly evolving product, ambitious partnership targets, and a rapidly growing organization.

What You Will Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager with focus on cloud technologies.

  • Experience building and supporting enterprise-grade products as a product manager, engineer or solutions architect.

  • Experience building, writing, maintaining and defending a clear product roadmap and backlog backed by user stories and customer research.

  • Excellent analytical, communication & collaboratio

Through a single, developer-friendly API with low-code embedded payment components, Payabli enables platforms to seamlessly embed, monetize, and operationalize payments—making payments a core part of their platform and business model.

By unifying payment acceptance, payment issuance, and advanced payment operations tooling, Payabli empowers software companies to manage and move money through a single infrastructure stack that delivers total control over the payments experience. Built to scale with PCI DSS 4.0 and SOC 2-compliant security, Payabli’s infrastructure delivers enterprise-grade reliability and trust while leveraging AI-driven intelligence to enhance visibility, streamline operations, and drive revenue growth.

This includes managing SMS as a channel—including 10DLC compliance in the US—email delivery, and other messaging infrastructure. Cluster Linking is how Kafka clusters are replicated, and it sits at the very core of Confluent. When a global bank architects zero-data-loss disaster recovery, when an enterprise migrates petabytes off open-source Kafka, or when a multinational replicates event streams across three continents, they're running on Cluster Linking.

This role will define the future of Cluster Linking: how we deliver seamless disaster recovery for Kafka workloads, how we build self-service migration paths into Confluent Cloud, and how we enable cross-organization data sharing to power real-time, operational data exchanges.

Cluster Linking is one of Confluent's fastest-growing platform products and you'll own that growth. Our largest customers depend on it, and because it cuts across Kafka, cloud infrastructure, networking, and security, your work will have visibility and influence across the company.

  • Launch and drive adoption for our one-click DR initiative. Take disaster recovery from a manually configured capability to a seamless, productized experience that customers can adopt with confidence.

  • Power capabilities that let customers migrate to Confluent in a few clicks or API calls. Define the art of the possible and make the migration path a reason to choose Confluent.

  • Drive results. Run campaigns with sellers and solutions engineers, lead webinars, assemble teams of subject matter experts, and do what it takes to move your priorities forward.

  • Influence and energize the people around you. Confluent moves fast and people are ready to help. Harness that, get teams excited, rally cross-functional support, and turn organizational momentum into product momentum.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer Payments
jobs.desc:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.


We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Consumer Payments to lead Toast’s consumer payments strategy and product area. This role will shape how diners pay across the Toast ecosystem, while also helping restaurants benefit from more seamless experiences, stronger guest loyalty, and improved economics.


In this role, you will define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution for consumer payment experiences at Toast. This includes card and stored value experiences, guest checkout innovation, loyalty- and rewards-linked payments, and emerging payment methods that improve both the guest experience and cost of acceptance.


You will work cross-functionally with teams across Consumer, Payments, Engineering, Design, Data, Risk, Operations, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, and Go-to-Market to turn an ambitious vision into a scalable and differentiated product portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of consumer experience, payments innovation, and business strategy, and requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, leadership, and comfort operating in ambiguity.


A day in the life (Responsibilities) 



  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Consumer Payments, aligning near-term execution with Toast’s long-term strategy.

  • Define the end-to-end consumer payment experience across areas such as wallet, stored value, guest checkout, rewards-linked payments, and emerging lower-cost payment methods.

  • Partner with Consumer and Guest teams to create payment experiences that are seamless, intuitive, and habit-forming for diners across Toast surfaces.

  • Work closely with other Payment teams, Risk, Finance, Legal, and Operations teams to design solutions that are compliant, scalable, and economically compelling.

  • Drive operational readiness & reliability. Define operational playbooks, observability, edge/online failover modes, and post-launch monitoring to ensure reliable in-store behavior and low support cost.

  • Champion field research & validation. Spend time in restaurants to learn operational workflows, validate prototypes, and iterate with real staff and guests.

Your role

As Lead Product Manager, you will own a set of Saturn's product areas in their entirety: strategy, roadmap, commercial outcomes, and the product managers who build them.a

Saturn is a Series A, Y Combinator-backed company building the AI-native operating system for financial advice. Our platform combines a living data model of the client, AI agents that complete complex advice and operational workflows, and compliance logic embedded directly into how work is produced. The initial wedge is adviser productivity. The larger opportunity is rebuilding the operating model of the advice firm around connected data, intelligent workflows and continuous regulatory control.

This is a lead role with founder-level scope. You work directly with the CEO, engineers, partnerships, and associate product managers. You define the what and why with enough clarity that one engineer ships the whole feature. No handoff chain, no ambiguity, no hand-waving. Your work will determine whether Saturn becomes the intelligence layer through which advice is created, governed and delivered.

The Team

You will work in a cross-functional squad alongside Product Engineers who own features end-to-end across frontend, backend, and AI, plus Design and Saturn’s domain experts: chartered compliance officers and paraplanners. Product management at Saturn moves fast, and we protect that pace deliberately. The best PMs do their best work when they can see the impact of what they ship.

What You'll Work On

  • Owning the product strategy and a rolling 3-6 month roadmap for AI agents that automate advice workflows
  • Translating agentic and LLM capabilities into experiences advisers trust with regulated work, where evidence and auditability sit behind every material output
  • Running independent discovery with advisers and paraplanners, distinguishing signal from noise, and turning adviser pain into product direction
  • Prioritising ruthlessly across features, bugs, and quality, and writing specs with zero ambiguity — clear enough for one engineer to ship the whole feature
  • Balancing enterprise partner demands with product coherence, and sequencing releases against the go-to-market calendar
  • Treating go-to-market as part of the build. You ship features that land, not features that launch
  • Coaching and multiplying the PMs around you, and building the frameworks the product function adopts as it grows

What We're Looking For

  • Product management experience at fast-paced, product-led B2B SaaS companies, including ownership of a product that shipped and won in market
  • AI-native product experience. You've shipped products where AI is the core, not a bolt-on. You understand the difference between deterministic and probabilistic systems, and what it takes to put agentic workflows in front of users in a regulated environment
  • Technical fluency. You can discuss AI architecture trade-offs, know why prompts break, and challenge engineering assumptions
  • Discovery discipline and sharp prioritisation. You have run research that changed what got built, and you can explain why you said no — not just what you said yes to
  • Commercial instinct. You connect product decisions to retention, expansion, and the revenue model
  • Self-sufficiency with data. You define your own metrics and design your own experiments
  • Strong written communication. Your decision docs and PRDs reduce meetings rather than create them

Preferred

  • Fintech or regulated industry experience

jobs.desc:
ABOUT RETELL AI

Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell's AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors, we've scaled to $80M in ARR with a team of 50, up from $5M at the start of 2025, and are now valued at over $1.5B.

Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we're creating intelligent AI “workers” that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction.

We're growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world.

Let's build the future together.

Recent recognition:

  • Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq & Wing VC

ABOUT THE ROLE

Retell AI transforms customer experience with voice AI for enterprises, including customers like CVS/Aetna, American Airlines, Lenovo, and Grab. We have more customer stories than we can tell!

This is a highly strategic, customer-facing role for operators who thrive at the intersection of technology, product, and execution.

As a Senior Agent Product Manager at Retell, you will work directly with some of the most innovative companies deploying AI-powered voice agents. You will lead implementations from initial discovery through production launch, helping customers redesign business processes around AI while ensuring successful technical delivery.

You will serve as a trusted advisor to executives, operators, and technical teams, helping customers define requirements, scope solutions, drive adoption, and realize measurable business outcomes. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success while helping shape the future of how enterprises deploy voice AI.

If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, working directly with customers, and owning outcomes from strategy through execution, this role offers an opportunity to operate at the center of one of the fastest-growing categories in AI.

  • Lead end-to-end customer deployments from discovery through production launch, owning project execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, and successful delivery.

  • Partner directly with customers to understand business goals, gather requirements, and translate them into scalable AI-powered workflows.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
San Francisco, CA · Full-time · In person

Screenpipe gives AI agents memory of your work. It keeps raw computer history local by default and makes that context available to the AI tools you choose.

We're looking for a senior PM who can make a powerful technical product simple and useful in everyday work.

You'll work directly with the founder and engineers, owning the path from understanding a customer's problem to shipping a change and seeing whether it helped.

What you'll own

  • Customer discovery. Talk to users regularly, watch them use the product, and understand what they are trying to get done.
  • The customer journey. Help people move from installing Screenpipe to getting a useful result and making it part of their routine.
  • Product priorities. Combine interviews, support feedback and product data to decide what matters next and what can wait.
  • Delivery. Turn problems into clear flows, prototypes and scoped work. Stay involved through implementation, release and follow-up.
  • Product outcomes. Define meaningful activation and retention measures, run focused experiments, and check whether changes improve real usage.
  • Trust. Treat privacy, permissions and clear explanations as part of the user experience.

What we're looking for

  • You've owned a software product end to end and can explain what you personally shipped, why you chose it and what happened afterward.
  • You have strong UX judgment and know how to test your assumptions with customers.
  • You're comfortable with product analytics, funnels and cohorts, including questioning how a metric is defined.
  • You can use AI tools to investigate problems and build prototypes, and work closely with engineers on technical tradeoffs.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and can make decisions with incomplete information.
  • You're based in San Francisco and want to work together in person.

Experience with early-stage products, desktop software, developer tools or AI agents is useful.

Why Screenpipe

This is a chance to shape how people use AI with the context of their actual work. You'll have direct access to users, a public codebase to learn from, and room to carry an idea from discovery through to a working product.

Benefits

  • Health and recovery: Personal health coach or trainer, gym membership, sauna and cold plunge access, and unlimited massages.
  • Health insurance: Top-tier health insurance.
  • Flexibility: San Francisco is our home base, with flexibility to work remotely from time to time, including trips abroad such as Thailand.
  • Learning: Unlimited books and audiobooks, on us.
  • AI tools: $20,000 per month in AI tokens to build, experiment, and do your best work.
  • Personal growth: Career and life coaching.
  • Team travel: Team trips and work retreats, including places like Hawaii.

Compensation

Base salary: $160,000 to $220,000 per year. Equity range: 0.25% to 1.00% on a fully diluted basis. Final compensation depends on experience and role scope. Any equity grant is subject to board approval, equity plan terms, vesting and definitive documents.

This role is full-time and in person in San Francisco. We are not offering visa sponsorship for this role.

Apply

Send us a product you helped build and a short explanation of your contribution. Include one example of a customer insight that changed what you shipped. Please use public examples or anonymize confidential details.

Explore Screenpipe and the codebase, then apply through YC.

HungerRush is a leading provider of integrated restaurant solutions. jobs.desc:
**About Us**
------------

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the consumer prediction-market trading experience end-to-end - web and mobile - once someone can fund: discovery, order entry, positions, parlays / live, and the fan UX that makes OG the default place to trade on real-world outcomes.

Your mandate is to make OG fast, clear, and design-obsessive for sports and prediction users: the core trading surfaces that keep them coming back, the workflows that feel native to fans (and to retail traders), and the translation of that craft into regulated U.S. event contracts. Fiat, KYC, and payment rails sit with a partner PM. You own what they do after they’re funded.

You will run this roadmap with independence. You make the call on UX tradeoffs, what ships when design quality isn’t there yet, and which trading patterns we borrow from sportsbooks, prediction apps, or retail perps -and which we refuse. You report to the Chief Product Officer, who sets product strategy and priorities across OG. You own the how and the when.

  

**You can come from one of three product worlds:**

* Native consumer predictions - sports fluency, parlays / live, fan UX - and you can bridge that into regulated event contracts.
* Prediction / event markets -you’ve already shipped this category.
* Retail perps / derivatives / advanced trading -you know trader-grade workflows and can make them accessible for fans, not only power users.
* If you’ve shipped any of those, this will feel familiar. The difference is you’ll be doing it in regulated U.S. prediction markets -where sports energy, consumer accessibility, and compliance collide, and the playbook for “best consumer trading experience in the category” is yours to write.

### **What You'll Actually Do:**

* Own the consumer trading roadmap. You are the DRI for web and mobile trading on OG -from first funded session through confident, repeat use. You set milestones, sequence work, and resolve cross-team dependencies. Nothing in this charter goes live without your sign-off on product and UX bar.
* Ship the product fans actually use. You prioritize market discovery, order entry, positions, parlays / multi-leg, live, and the workflows that keep sports and prediction users engaged. You kill “nice ideas” that don’t move outcomes.
* Bridge native prediction (or perps) into regulated event contracts. You take patterns fans already know -sportsbooks, prediction apps, or retail advanced trading -and make them work under U.S. event-contract rules. You don’t copy a sportsbook blindly. You decide what translates.
* Hold the design bar. You champion usability and aesthetics as non-negotiable. You live in design reviews and give specific, actionable UX feedback -spacing, interaction patterns, information density, not vibes. Fan UX is a product skill, not a polish pass.

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. This role owns a product area end to end. Where the product marketer is the market lens, you are the person accountable for what we build, how it works, and whether it ships and succeeds.

You work at the center of the product organization, translating a clear point of view into shipped work that moves MINERVA and the COGENT architecture forward through each GR/GA milestone.

========================

In an AI market where capabilities can be copied in weeks, the advantage goes to teams that decide well and ship fast. Someone has to hold the point of view, make the calls, and keep a team building the right thing.

Define how domain objects and large-scale geospatial, imagery, inspection, and operational datasets are represented, connected, processed, governed, and exposed to applications, customers, and AI systems. **Senior Product Manager, Consumer**
------------------------------------

**Location:** Remote (U.S.-based) Preference given to CA, TX and FL  
**Department:** Product  
**Reports to:** Chief Product Officer  
**Starting Pay Range**: $155k - $172k/yr

### **About Work Truck Solutions**

Work Truck Solutions is the **operating system for the commercial vehicle industry.** While the retail auto market is saturated with software, the $130B+ commercial truck market was operating in the dark—until we turned on the lights.  
  
We are the only platform that connects the entire ecosystem: OEMs, upfitters, dealerships, and fleet buyers. By digitizing complex inventory data (chassis + upfits) and streamlining the supply chain, we don't just help dealers sell trucks; we ensure American businesses get the mission-critical vehicles they need to work. We are a team of innovators, disruptors, and problem-solvers dedicated to one mission: removing the friction from the commercial vehicle industry. We are profitable, growing, and aggressively scaling our technology to remain the undisputed authority in this space.

### **The Opportunity**

We are seeking a **Senior Product Manager** to own a core area of the platform end to end—from the problem definition through to the metric that proves it worked.  
  
This is not a backlog-grooming role. Our users are dealers, upfitters, OEMs, and fleet buyers whose workflows are genuinely complicated, whose data is genuinely messy, and who will tell you plainly when software wastes their time. You will spend real hours in the field understanding how a fleet buyer thinks about their truck, how it gets specced, upfitted, listed, and sold, then translate that into products that make the whole supply chain faster. You will also help define how AI shows up in our products—which parts of these workflows should be automated, augmented, or left alone—and hold the line on quality when the easy answer is to ship a demo.  
  
You'll work closely with design, engineering, and data to sequence work that compounds, and you'll be measured on outcomes for the business and our customers rather than on shipping velocity.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own strategy, roadmap, and execution for our Consumer shopping experience, including the tradeoffs required to keep it focused.
* Develop deep, first-hand understanding of dealer, upfitter, OEM, and fleet buyer workflows through customer conversations, ride-alongs, support data, and usage analytics.
* Write crisp problem definitions, specs, and success criteria that give engineering and design room to solve rather than instructions to follow.
* Define and instrument the metrics that matter for your area; run the analysis yourself rather than waiting on a request queue.
* Partner with design on discovery and validation, and with engineering on sequencing, scope, and technical tradeoffs.
* Identify where AI and ML meaningfully improve the product—data enrichment, search and matching, workflow automation, decision support—and scope those bets with honest evaluation criteria and clear failure modes.
* Drive launches end to end: enablement for sales and support, customer communication, adoption tracking, and iteration after release.
* Communicate up and out: keep executives, GTM teams, and customers aligned on what's coming, what changed, and why.
* Contribute to the broader product operating model—discovery practices, prioritization frameworks, and how the team makes decisions.

### **Qualifications**

**Product craft**  

* 6+ years in product management, with at least one area or product line you owned end to end and can speak to in detail—including what didn't work.
* Demonstrated experience with complex B2B or marketplace products, ideally multi-sided, where different user groups have conflicting incentives.
* Strong discovery instincts: you talk to users regularly, you distinguish what they ask for from what they need, and you kill your own ideas when the evidence says to

jobs.desc:
**About Us**
------------

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

**About the Company**

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

**Role Summary**

Fanatics Collectibles is looking for a **Senior Product Manager, Supply Chain Technology** to build the products and technology that enable a scalable, connected, and efficient global supply chain.

You'll define product strategy and roadmaps for technology that helps our teams plan effectively, improve inventory and operational visibility, streamline workflows, and move products through the supply chain with greater speed and confidence.

Working closely with Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Finance, and Product, you'll turn complex operational challenges into scalable technology solutions. Success means creating products that make our supply chain more efficient, resilient, and easier to operate as Fanatics Collectibles continues to grow.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Own product strategy and roadmaps for key Supply Chain Technology capabilities.
* Partner with supply chain teams to identify operational challenges and opportunities where technology can drive meaningful improvement.
* Build products that improve planning, inventory visibility, operational workflows, and decision-making.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, connect fragmented systems and data, and simplify complex workflows.
* Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and priorities.
* Partner closely with Engineering throughout discovery, development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Balance immediate operational needs with longer-term platform investments and scalability.
* Define success metrics and use data and customer feedback to measure impact and guide product decisions.
* Align cross-functional stakeholders around priorities, tradeoffs, and technology investments.

#### **What You'll Bring**

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Student Experience
jobs.desc:
**About Stepful**:

Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.

Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.

Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.

Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025.

**Our values**:

We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

* **Care first**: We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.
* **Learn quickly**: We test, learn with data, and iterate.
* **Build together**: We win when we rely on each other.
* **Own it**: We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

**The opportunity:**
--------------------

Thousands of adult learners come to Stepful to change their lives, often while balancing full-time jobs, families, and financial pressure. Our Student Experience teams build the classroom experience for all of our learners. Every step of their journey matters, from their first day of class through graduation, certification and final licensing exams. As the Product Manager for Student Experience, you'll own the product that carries them through that journey. You won't just optimize what exists. You'll question it, rethink how we deliver outcomes, and build experiences that help more students finish, get certified, and get hired.

This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Product Management and partners closely with the Student Experience team, including student success coaches, instructors, and career services, as well as design, engineering, data, and marketing.

This is a hybrid opportunity based out of our NYC office, requiring three days/week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) in office.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for the end-to-end student experience for both our D2C and B2B2C business, from onboarding and live instruction through graduation.
* Challenge long-held assumptions about how students learn and progress, and bring bold, evidence-backed ideas for improving completion, certification pass rates, and job outcomes.
* Partner closely with the Student Experience team to understand where students get stuck, and decide what should be solved with product, with process, or with people.
* Talk to students regularly through interviews, usability sessions, and feedback loops so their real needs shape what we build.
* Run a disciplined experimentation program with A/B tests and rapid prototypes to learn quickly and scale what works.
* Collaborate with designers and engineers to ship intuitive, mobile-friendly experiences for learners who are often studying on the go.
* Use AI and automation to deliver more personal support at scale, so tech empowers our coaches and instructors instead of replacing them.
* Define and track success metrics tied to student engagement, retention, completion, satisfaction (NPS), and job placement. We're not a feature factory and have no intention of becoming one!

**What you'll bring:**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record building consumer-facing products
* Proven success moving engagement, retention, or conversion metrics for a large user base, with launches you can point to
* Strong p

jobs.desc:
**The Role:**

As a digitally native company, Minted's Shopping Experience and commerce platform are core to the company's success. Minted's online shopping experience allows consumers to discover, customize, and purchase from an extensive assortment of products and categories, all designed by independent artists around the world. We are driven by creating a customer journey that serves both our artist community and the savvy e-commerce shopper.

We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to own the strategy for how customers find and choose products on Minted. Over the next two years, we are integrating a new product information management platform, which will give us structured, machine-readable data about our product catalog. That data supports a set of experiences we cannot build today: search and browse that understand what a customer is looking for, product detail and category pages generated from product attributes, and filtered navigation that is fully crawlable. Combined with parallel investments in analytics, customer data, and content management, it is the foundation for conversational shopping and for deep personalization later. This role decides what we build on that foundation, in what order, and why.

The role spans our discovery surfaces (search, browse, category, and product detail) and our conversion optimization program, with dependencies running into product data, customization and rendering, checkout, and marketing. You will set the strategy and objectives for your pod, lead initiatives that cross pod and functional boundaries, and raise the standard of product craft for the PMs around you.

### **You will:**

* Set the strategy for Minted's discovery experience in partnership with engineering and design: where to play and how to win across search, browse, category, and product detail. Derive it from business strategy, the competitive environment, behavioral data, test results, customer insight, and technical constraints and capabilities.
* Prioritize the growth levers that move our targets, then prioritize the customer problems that move those levers, then consider the solution space. Up-level the organization by holding that sequence when others want to start with solutions.
* Set the objectives, key results, roadmap, and initiative scope consistent with that strategy, along with the sequencing and the resourcing implications. Carry a two-year planning view alongside the near-term roadmap.
* Own and continuously maintain the prioritized list of customer problems across your surfaces, keeping it current with fresh behavioral data, user research, customer support and concierge signals, session replay, dogfooding, and competitive scans.
* Define the strategy for turning our new product data foundation into customer value, and lead its execution: attribute-driven search and browse, dynamic product detail and category pages, crawlable filtered navigation, and the groundwork for conversational shopping and deeply personalized discovery.
* Develop and lead initiative strategies that span multiple teams and functions, and resolve the dependencies and disagreements those initiatives create with other teams and with stakeholders.
* Shape solutions with engineering and design. You hold the business problem and the value case, design holds the experience, engineering holds feasibility and cost. Your job is to find the right-sized solution where the three meet.
* Argue for defensibility in addition to value. Ask whether a bet is hard for a competitor to copy and whether it improves margin, and be willing to kill an idea that does not clear the bar.
* Set a new standard for rationale and foresight with the briefs and documentation you produce, stating the assumptions, the growth lever, the customer problem, the success criteria, and the instrumentation plan explicitly.

**About us:**

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that's gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested **over $2 billion** in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than **100 countries** and **over 5 million** borrowers

As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva's team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.

#### **Kiva's values:**

Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.

Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.

Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. - Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.

Honor and integrity - Do the most right thing in the most right way. Cherish diversity and respect each other.

Love and kindness always - Say what you mean. Mean what you say. And don't say it mean. Clarity. Courage. Kindness.

Product managers at Kiva take extreme ownership and roll up their sleeves to step in where help is needed. We understand our users and prioritize impact first. In this role, you will report to the Head of Product. You will identify and evaluate new product opportunities across our B2C and B2B audiences, starting with the high-net-worth individual audience. You will decide what gets built and why, define what success looks like, and stay accountable for results. We are product builders and stay involved from crafting the strategic vision to speaking with users, creating prototypes, defining requirements, evaluating tradeoffs, and measuring results. Join Our Team as a ***Senior Product Manager***

If you’re a product leader who is tired of slow decision-making, fragmented ownership, and ideas that never get implemented—this is your opportunity to do it differently.

At Orion180, Senior Product Managers don’t just manage and maintain insurance products. jobs.title: CHMG Product Manager Senior
jobs.desc:
The role is responsible for owning and delivering one or more products or initiatives that support Medical Group clinical operations, performance outcomes, and leader decision-making. This role manages complex products within an assigned domain and ensures solutions deliver measurable value and are adopted effectively.
  
The role owns the end-to-end product lifecycle—from problem definition through implementation and sustained performance—and partners with clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders to translate Medical Group priorities into actionable, scalable solutions. This role may be assigned to different product domains or initiatives over time based on Medical Group priorities and operates with limited supervision.Essential Job Function
  
Product Ownership Delivery
  
  

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of assigned products or initiatives, from discovery and definition through implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Translate Medical Group priorities and stakeholder needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and measurable success criteria.
* Develop and maintain product roadmaps that balance near-term delivery with longer-term objectives.
* Design solutions grounded in a strong understanding of clinical and operational workflows.

Stakeholder Engagement Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with clinical, operational, and administrative leaders to understand needs, validate solutions, and drive adoption.
* Engage subject matter experts to inform product design and ensure practical, usable outcomes.
* Collaborate with planning, project management, education, optimization, analytics, and IT teams to ensure coordinated delivery.
* Communicate product priorities, progress, risks, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders.

Analytics, Insights, and Performance Support
  
  

* Use data, reporting, and feedback to assess product performance and guide improvement.
* Ensure products provide timely, actionable information that supports accountability and decision-making.
* Promote transparency, data quality, and appropriate data use within assigned products.

Operational Excellence Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Monitor adoption and performance outcomes, using insights to drive iterative enhancements.
* Ensure solutions align with applicable regulatory, privacy, security, and governance standards.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce variation, and improve operational efficiency.
* Contribute to shared product management practices and standards within the Medical Group.

Education
  
  

* Required: Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, industrial/management engineering, operations, or a related field and or equivalent training and experience.

Experience
  
  

* Required: Minimum of 5 years work experience in healthcare operations, clinical workflows, analytics, product management. Demonstrated experience designing workflows and standard work in clinical or operational settings

Demonstrated success managing products or complex initiatives from concept through implementation and sustained adoption.
  

* Strong product mindset with experience working in cross-functional, matrixed environments.
* Ability to engage effectively with clinical, operational, and technical partners.
* Experience translating complex needs into clear requirements and usable solutions.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero
jobs.desc:
##### **Integration meets Innovation**

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we're on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

Celigo is looking for a **Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero** to own the highest-leverage program in the company: running Celigo on Celigo. When GTO operates on our own platform across GTM, CX, and G&A systems, we become our own best customer. We discover what's hard before customers find it, feed it directly into Product, and give Sales a credible, live reference in every deal. This role is the dedicated owner of that program, end-to-end.

##### **What would you do if hired?**

* Own the Customer Zero program as a funded initiative with a real roadmap, clear outcomes, and an operating rhythm that holds across competing priorities. You set the pace, define what done looks like, and keep the work alive without needing someone to push it. You measure yourself by business value delivered, not by meetings held.
* Drive adoption of Celigo's own products (agents, MCP, Ora/CLI, integrations) inside GTO's GTM, CX, and G&A systems. When you run into friction, you dig into it before being asked. Surface what's genuinely hard, prioritize it, and shepherd it into Product's roadmap in partnership with the CPO's org.
* Use Celigo's AI-powered platform as part of how you work every day. You will be one of the first people inside the company to push on new agentic capabilities, give Product honest feedback on where they deliver and where they fall short, and help define what "AI-first" actually looks like inside an enterprise workflow. Your daily use is part of the feedback loop.
* Bring product discipline to every workstream: defined requirements, clear success criteria, and prioritization grounded in adoption and business value. Committed dates should hold because you've done the thinking up front, shipping the smallest version that delivers real value and iterating from there rather than waiting for a perfect build.
* Operate in both hats simultaneously: design the underlying business processes and own the solution as a product manager. You're the person who figures out how the process should work and the person accountable for whether what ships delivers an outstanding experience.
* Weigh user needs against security, privacy, and governance considerations (RBAC, permissions, service accounts), making trade-offs deliberately rather than after the fact. Build the prescriptive playbook Product and Sales need: governance patterns, reference architectures, and proof points that hold up in enterprise conversations.
* Be the external face of how Celigo runs on Celigo. Present at flagship events, join key customer and prospect conversations, and package our internal use into references Sales can put in front of prospects and existing customers. Enable Product Marketing and Sales to scale the story beyond you.

##### **Who are we looking for?**

**Skills & Abilities**

* You're energized by building something that doesn't fully exist yet. You ask the questions others skip past, including the uncomfortable ones about what's actually broken, and you treat ambiguity as the job, not an obstacle to it.
* You connect your work to the bigger picture. You understand why Customer Zero matters to the company, and you make decisions that serve that outcome, including the trade-offs nobody told you to make. You ask "why" before "how."
* You ship the smallest version that delivers real value and iterate on real feedback. A 10-slide internal use case that lands in one deal is better than a perfect playbook no one has read. You recover quickly when something doesn't land, without drama.
* You treat the program's problems as your own. You move
