For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron's for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients' best interests — always.\*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* *Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron's top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron's to use the ranking in marketing. **Job Summary:**

As the Senior Product Manager you are responsible for managing and executing the digital experiences and technologies that support our growth. As a key-leader on our cross-functional team, you will be co-accountable for our OKRs.

You will provide organizational vision, leadership and strategy for our processes and products. You will be deeply hands on with the related technology (ensuring exceptional product day-to-day administration, data quality, user support) as well as establishing the long term vision, managing the overall roadmap enhancements, including system architecture, custom development, data integration, and ongoing release management. To be successful in this role, you must both have terrific operational skills and be able to think strategically about how the products can further enhance our business and how to successfully integrate acquired firms. jobs.title: Group Product Manager, SMB Accounting
jobs.desc:
About the Role:

At H&R Block, we are in search of people with bold ideas who want to make a difference and help transform the company. When you come and work with us, you are joining a group that is grounded in the spirit of entrepreneurship - nimble, quick, self-starters who are drawn to try new things. We need innovators, creators, and achievers like you who are ready to challenge and disrupt an entire industry.

The Group Product Manager, SMB Accounting is a strategic product leader responsible for owning the core accounting and bookkeeping experience at the heart of the Wave/Small Business product suite - the product that most directly determines whether a small business owner trusts us with their books, day in and day out. This leader will manage a team of Product Managers. This is a coach-player role - the ideal candidate is energized by both individual contribution and people leadership, and knows when to shift between them based on what the business needs.

They will lead their team in translating strategy into execution, ensuring product outcomes align with business and customer needs. They will manage product budgets, oversee their product team, and promote best practices in product development and discovery - with particular attention to the accounting/bookkeeping domain's regulatory, data-integrity, and trust requirements. This position requires a blend of domain expertise, hands-on product management, and steady leadership through a period of transition.

**Day to day, you'll...**
-------------------------

* Define and lead the product vision, strategy, roadmap, OKRs, and success metrics for the SMB Accounting group, ensuring the core bookkeeping experience keeps pace with the needs of growing small businesses and solopreneurs
* Own accounting/bookkeeping product decisions with the judgment the domain demands - balancing usability, accuracy, and compliance in a product small business owners depend on to run their financial lives
* Partner closely with Tax and cross-platform counterparts to help unify accounting and tax workflows as part of the broader SMB platform strategy, ensuring the accounting experience integrates cleanly with adjacent products rather than operating in a silo
* Own and evolve the mobile accounting experience, establishing the roadmap and driving alignment across engineering, design, and business stakeholders on mobile direction - mobile experience delivery is a hard requirement for this role

The People Product team builds the internal tools and frameworks that power every employee's journey across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt. Range setting is the starting point, as it is the core process of a compensation team and the infrastructure everything else is built on. Your role is to turn that into a product: a range-setting workspace that ingests market and internal data to enable a Compensation Partner to review and make decisions.

This is an individual contributor role with a clearly scoped product area. The range-setting tool and the monitoring dashboard are the anchor. We started Vehlo in 2019 with a simple goal: to be the industry’s favorite provider of repair shop technology.

Across every part of the auto repair industry, Vehlo is igniting vehicle service success with software and financial solutions that unlock your potential. Our founder-led products power the entire service lane experience and keep customers coming back with streamlined tools that help you handle communication, workflow automation, touchless payments, valet pickup, and much more. We’re out to simplify the customer journey from start to finish and give power back to the people under the hood, making their jobs easier and your shop more profitable —just ask our over 30,000 customers, who generate more than 60M annual repair orders, and process over $12B in payments volume annually. At Vehlo, our only purpose is your success, and together, we’re reaching your goals faster than ever.

Being a Veep comes with more than a comprehensive benefits package—our biggest benefit is opportunity: Opportunity to make an impact, opportunity for growth, and opportunity for recognition and rewards. This is not a mega-corporation where you wonder what people are doing all day - every Veep is moving the ball forward day in, day out for our customers or for each other.

**About This Role:**

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own our customer-facing data, analytics and insights portfolio end to end. Most of our customers buy more than one Vehlo product and then cobble together other solutions to assemble the 360-degree view of their business that we don't yet give them natively.

Closing that gap is the starting point, but the bigger opportunity is what we build on top of it. We're not looking for someone to ship more dashboards. More value will come from AI-powered insights that tell an operator what's happening in their business and what to do about it, without them having to know what to ask.

At Vehlo, a Principal Product role is senior, highly visible, and hands-on, reporting to the SVP of Product. You won't have direct reports on day one, but that could change as we grow the business. You'll own strategy and set the pace of play while leading through partners in engineering, analytics, customer success and go-to-market. You'll drive the commercial model as well as the product: what it costs us to serve, what belongs in which tier, and what customers pay for.

**What You'll Do:**

* New AI-powered insight products, built zero to one: surfacing what an operator would never have thought to ask, explaining why a number moved, predicting what's coming, and recommending the next action, delivered inside the workflow rather than in a separate analytics destination.
* The premium analytics product line end to end: reporting and dashboard experiences, alerting, natural-language reporting, and meaningful additions to the basic reporting built into individual products.
* The cross-product view: one unified analytics experience spanning a customer's entire Vehlo footprint.
* Data delivery beyond the dashboard: APIs, MCP surfaces, exports, warehouse sharing, BI connectors, and the access model that governs which customer sees which data.
* The semantic layer and the metric definitions inside it, across products that were built separately and don't yet agree with each other.
* Pricing, packaging, and unit economics: cost-to-serve per location, what's free because it drives retention, and what's genuinely a paid tier.
* Aggregate benchmarking and market-intelligence products built from our repair data, along with the data-rights and aggregation model that makes them defensible.
* Data quality and customer trust as measured product outcomes, so we reinforce trust and value in the market.

**In your first 90 days**

* Align the teams on a governance model so everyone knows what every number in our analytics product means and where it comes from.
* Build a cost-to-serve model per location that our finance team accepts.
*

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Matching
jobs.desc:
**Description**

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

Every lead sent to our premium customers is vetted and live-transferred to an agent through our Concierge Call Center, and which agent gets that lead is decided by a matching model that increasingly encodes customer-specific business rules, for example price-point eligibility or agent tier restrictions.

This role owns that matching model and everything downstream of it: the agent handoff experience, and the smaller product issues premium customers currently experience as bugs in that flow. You'll have a dedicated engineering team building this with you, and you'll work closely with the teams that own the customer-facing applications where these rules surface.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* The matching model: which agent receives a vetted lead, including customer-configurable eligibility and preference rules (e.g. price-point-based agent restrictions) that surface in customer-facing applications.
* Answer-to-Claim and the agent handoff experience: the flow from a vetted lead to a claimed, worked lead.
* Smaller improvements: fixes and refinements to issues premium customers currently perceive as bugs in the handoff experience.
* Claim Rate and Assignment Rate: the two funnel metrics that roll up, together with the Call Center Platform PM's metrics, into overall Live Transfer Rate.

**What you won't own today**
----------------------------

Call-center infrastructure sits with the Call Center Platform PM today. As the two roles mature this scope could expand to include call-center infrastructure.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the roadmap for the matching mechanism in close collaboration with the customer experience teams, prioritized against Claim Rate and Assignment Rate impact
* Partner with engineering to turn customer-specific eligibility and preference rules into scalable configuration, not one-off logic per customer.
* Work with the teams owning customer-facing applications to ship the surfaces where customers set or see their matching rules.
* Triage and prioritize the smaller features premium customers experience as bugs in the handoff flow, and decide what's a quick fix versus a roadmap item.
* Track and report on Claim Rate and Assignment Rate, and how they roll up into overall Live Transfer Rate.
* Coordinate with the Call Center Platform PM to keep the boundary between matching logic and call-center execution clean, and help redraw that boundary if the role's scope expands.
* Represent this domain in planning, prioritization, and leadership reviews.

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* 8+ years of Product Management experience with a track record of owning complex business logic or decisioning systems, not just user-facing features.
* Experience working in marketplaces or lead-gen models where allocation, matching, or eligibility rules directly affect revenue.
* Comfort translating customer-facing configuration needs (pricing tiers, eligibility rules) into product and engineering requirements.
* A track record of driving measurable funnel metrics (conversion, claim, assignment, or similar) rather than shipping features and hoping they help.
* Strong cross-functional partnership skills. You'll coordinate closel

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

* Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021
* Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide
* Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

**About the Team**
------------------

Data Infrastructure builds the platform that every other data team stands on: access to shared data, orchestration, data ingestion, and the retirement of systems the company has outgrown. Every layer of this platform exists to make it easier for a homeowner to hire an Angi Pro, on one certified source of truth that people and AI agents can trust equally.

The team's strategy is built around one idea: this platform should feel like a self-service product, not a ticket queue, for the engineers and analysts who depend on it, and increasingly for the AI agents who depend on it too. Angi is moving toward AI agents as a normal way of building and operating, and every agent that touches company data comes through this platform first.

This role stewards that platform's product direction.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Product Management**

* Manage governed platform access - give engineers, analysts, and services safe, auditable access to shared data, and make the safe path the easy path.

* Oversee legacy system retirement - close out systems that are no longer the source of truth, with clear ownership handed off at every step.
* Optimize compute cost efficiency - find where cost comes from habit rather than real need, and bring it down without anyone losing the developer experience they rely on.
* Advance compute strategy diversification - help move the platform toward a storage layer that works with more than one compute engine, so each workload runs on the engine built for it.
* Build the platform's AI-ready substrate - make agentic workflows safe by default, with the same governed access and audit trail for an agent as for a person.

**Execution and Individual Contribution**

* Use AI agents in your own daily work, set clear norms so the engineers and peers around you feel safe experimenting with agents and agentic workflows.
* Protect the team's focus and drive real rigor without micromanaging how the work gets done. Steward outcomes, not tasks.
* Build trust across engineering, domain teams, and leadership through empathetic, transparent, and clear communication when addressing complex challenges.
* Work closely with Data Engineering's other delivery teams - Data Mesh Enablement and Managed Data Products - and with the team building Angi's agentic workflows, toward one overall technical strategy.

* Five or more years of product management experience on a data or infrastructure platform team, where you stewarded technical roadmaps directly.
* Comfortable reading system architecture and pipeline dependencies well enough to make real sequencing calls with engineering.
* A record of taking cross-team migrations and retirements all the way to done, not just to a plan.

jobs.desc:
#### **Job Description**

We’re hiring a dedicated product manager to own B2C ecommerce, conversion rate optimization and payments. You’ll shape our custom commerce platform and prioritize improvements to the business throughout the transition.

You’ll work directly with our head of tech, engineers, data engineer, finance, marketing and showroom operations.

#### **Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Product roadmap: prioritize customer and business problems across discovery, ring configuration, appointments, cart, checkout and payments
* Customer insight: combine customer conversations, showroom feedback, support issues and behavioral data to identify friction
* CRO: develop hypotheses, select appropriate experiments and make rollout decisions from measured results
* Full-funnel measurement: connect website behavior to online purchases, appointment bookings, attendance and subsequent showroom sales
* Payments experience: improve payment completion, deposits, balance payments, refunds and recovery from failed payments
* Provider evaluation: assess payment and financing options with finance, including cost, approval rates, fraud and operational effort
* Delivery: write clear requirements and acceptance criteria, resolve scope decisions and coordinate business acceptance testing
* Migration readiness: define essential launch capabilities, sequence releases and coordinate staff readiness with operations

#### **Requirements and Experience:**

* B2C product ownership: a record of owning an ecommerce product or a substantial purchase funnel
* CRO results: measurable improvements in conversion or purchase completion, with a clear explanation of how you assessed the result
* Payments experience: direct work with checkout, payment providers, authorization rates, refunds or chargebacks
* Analytical judgment: ability to define reliable metrics, interpret experiments and work with a data engineer to validate measurement
* Commercial understanding: ability to assess conversion gains alongside margin, payment costs, cancellations and support burden
* Technical fluency: comfort discussing APIs, integrations, data dependencies and release tradeoffs with engineers
* Delivery ownership: ability to make prioritization decisions and stay involved through launch, measurement and iteration
* High-consideration retail: jewelry, luxury, configurable products or other purchases involving a longer decision process
* Connected channels: customer journeys spanning ecommerce and physical locations
* Commerce migrations: replacing a live platform while maintaining day-to-day trading

Success in this role means more completed, profitable purchases across online and showroom channels, improved payment completion and a roadmap focused on the highest-value customer problems.

#### **Job Details:**

* Schedule: We work Eastern Time US hours.
* Salary: $145,000-$180,000 based on experience

#### **Benefits:**

* **Equity Compensation.** Every Frank Darling team member receives a stock option package to share in the company's upside.
* **Insurance.** Medical, dental, and vision insurance kicks in on the first day of your 2nd month!
* **401k.** Optional 401k program.
* **Paid Time Off.** Flexible, unlimited paid time off policy enables motivated, goal-oriented team members to recharge
* **Disability and Life Insurance.**
* **Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits.**
* **Employee Discounts.** A generous discount program for you, your friends, and your family to make it easy to wear and gift Frank Darling.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Hi! We're Forerunner.**
-------------------------

We're on a mission to help communities adapt to a changing world. Forerunner builds modern, easy-to-use software for the people who keep communities running. Local governments, federal agencies, and infrastructure operators use Forerunner to run inspections, enforce codes, manage public works, respond to disasters, and meet their regulatory obligations.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to lead product for the Field Intelligence team.

You’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Forerunner helps field teams understand what needs attention, capture trustworthy information, and turn their findings into action. This includes mobile and offline workflows, AI-guided inspections, geospatial context, photo and voice capture, operational visibility, and the connection between field observations and downstream compliance or corrective-action workflows.

This is a high-ownership role for a hands-on product builder who enjoys getting close to users, making sense of complicated operational environments, and turning that understanding into clear product direction and tangible solutions. Depending on the problem, that might mean sketching a workflow, building a lightweight prototype with modern tools, digging into usage data, writing detailed product behavior, or working directly with customers to test the riskiest assumption.

You’ll work closely with Engineering and Design from discovery through delivery, while partnering with Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to ensure what we build is adopted and creates measurable value.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for Field Intelligence, from work planning and data capture through review, follow-up, and resolution.
* Spend time with inspectors, field crews, program managers, and operational leaders to understand how work happens in practice.
* Identify the highest-leverage opportunities for AI to improve fieldwork while preserving user control, transparency, and trust.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design to frame problems, evaluate tradeoffs, define requirements, and ship polished end-to-end experiences across mobile and web.
* Define how we measure success, including adoption, task completion, data quality, time saved, issue-resolution time, and customer outcomes.
* Lead product discovery through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, pilots, usage data, and structured experimentation.
* Balance immediate customer needs with investments in shared platform capabilities, reliability, and long-term product differentiation.
* Develop thoughtful rollout and change-management plans for workflows used in regulated and operationally critical environments.
* Equip Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing with a clear product narrative, launch materials, demonstrations, and the context needed to support adoption.
* Communicate priorities, decisions, risks, and learnings clearly across the company.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of a complex product area from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Excellent product judgment. You can separate urgent requests from durable needs, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and turn ambiguous problems into focused product bets.
* A builder’s mindset. You don’t stop at setting direction or managing delivery. You use prototypes, data, workflow models, technical exploration, and other hands-on methods to learn quickly and help the team arrive at a better product.
* Experience shipping AI-powered product experiences to real users. You understand what it takes to make them trustworthy in production, including evaluation, failure modes, guardrails, and iteration based on real-world behavior.
* Strong customer instincts and experience learning from users whose work is operational

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data & Analytics
jobs.desc:
* United States; Holmdel, New Jersey
* Product Management
* Full Time
* Remote
* 6595

  

**Job Overview**  
  
  

As a Senior Product Manager, Data & Analytics you will lead the strategy, development, and delivery of a portfolio of data and analytics products, including customer-facing analytics solutions, data delivery products, and the common data platform that serves as the foundation for scalable reporting, analytics, AI, and future data products across the organization. Your focus will be on driving data product strategy, executing roadmaps, and delivering enterprise-scale SaaS, analytics, and data platform solutions. You will work closely with product owners, engineering, analytics, data science, architecture, sales, marketing, customer success, and executive stakeholders, you will drive the end-to-end lifecycle of data products, from discovery through market launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement. This role requires a combination of product leadership, technical fluency, commercial acumen, and a proven track record of bringing data products to market.

  
  
**About Us**  
  
  

ICIMS is a leading enterprise hiring platform that combines the scale and reliability of enterprise software with the transformative power of AI. Thousands of organizations across more than 200 countries and territories trust ICIMS to find and hire the people who shape their future and drive their business forward. Powered by insights from billions of hiring interactions, continuous AI innovation, and a highly extensible platform, ICIMS helps organizations turn talent acquisition into a competitive advantage. For more than 25 years, ICIMS has delivered end-to-end hiring solutions that improve recruiting efficiency, reduce costs and create exceptional candidate experiences.

  

ICIMS helps solve one of the biggest challenges businesses face today: building a workforce that can adapt, scale, and perform in an increasingly competitive and unpredictable talent market. We uniquely do that by combining enterprise-grade hiring technology, AI-powered insights and automation, and connected talent experiences to help organizations improve hiring outcomes while driving measurable impact.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
  

**Product Strategy and Roadmap (Discovery):**

* Define and evolve the vision, strategy, and roadmap for customer-facing analytics, data feeds, internal analytics solutions, and the Common Data Platform.
* Develop investment strategies that balance customer needs, business priorities, and platform scalability.
* Define and own product outcomes, success metrics, and long-term growth strategies.
* Identify market opportunities and customer needs through research, customer engagement, competitive analysis, and quantitative insights.
* Partner with product owners across analytics, platform, and application domains to align priorities, dependencies, and outcomes across the portfolio.
* Establish a long-term strategy for shared data assets, reporting frameworks, analytics capabilities, data extraction services, and platform services.
* Act as the primary voice of the customer for data and analytics products, ensuring customer needs are represented throughout the product lifecycle.
* Knowledgeable of Privacy by Design (PbD) guidelines and processes; able to identify privacy risks and successfully complete discovery assessments.

**Product Development (Development):**

* Partner with engineering, data engineering, analytics, architecture, and data science teams to ensure delivery aligns with product strategy and customer needs.
* Define and prioritize product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success measures.
* Drive development of reusable data assets, common data models, APIs, integration frameworks, and analytics capabilities that enable multiple downstream products.
* Serve as the bridge between stakeholders including executives, sales, marketing, customer success, support, legal, compliance, and engineering

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Digital Assets
jobs.desc:
**About the Company**

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem.

Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

  

#### **About the role**

CertiK works with banks, regulators and regulated financial institutions that adopt digital assets. We build regulatory technology for these markets, and we are hiring a lead product manager to own what we build next for these clients.

You will gather client needs directly and through our client-facing consultants, turn them into a clear, prioritized roadmap, and present our products to clients, prospects and regulators in North America and, when needed, abroad. Inside the company, you represent the customer.

### **What you'll do**

* Run discovery with clients and prospects, on site and remotely, and work closely with the solutions consultants to set the agenda for what they learn in the field
* Build and run a discovery channel of your own: a panel of compliance, risk and operations practitioners at banks, VASPs and regulators for structured (including paid) interviews, so requirements never depend on a single client
* Convert client conversations and consultant findings into actionable, prioritized product and feature decisions, with the reason behind each request documented, and defend the ranking to leadership
* Present CertiK's products and services to client teams, prospects and regulators in demos, workshops and tender presentations
* Join Business Development and consultants on key client visits, primarily in the US, with occasional travel to Europe, the Middle East and other markets
* Own the roadmap conversation with the CEO, Business Development and Engineering

### **Requirements**

* 5–8 years in B2B product management, ideally in fintech, regtech, compliance software or at a regulated financial institution
* Domain experience in financial crime, AML or transaction monitoring, blockchain intelligence, or risk and surveillance products, whether as a product manager or from inside a compliance function
* Has led complete product cycles from discovery to launch in a regulated or enterprise domain, with demonstrated ability to identify the underlying need behind a client's stated request and show how it changed what was built
* Native or fully proficient English, with professional presentation skills to senior compliance, risk and regulatory audiences
* Established prioritization framework and a record of turning customer input into shipped features
* Sufficient technical fluency to challenge engineering decisions and hold a position under pushback
* Directs discovery through others as well as first-hand: part of the customer input comes via consultants, and the role sets their agenda
* Regular travel within the US and international travel as required

### **Bonus points**

* Prior product experience at a blockchain intelligence or crypto compliance platform
* Familiarity with FATF, Travel Rule, sanctions or MiCA-type requirements as they apply to digital assets
* Familiarity with US, UK or EU digital asset regulation
* Experience working with regulators or on regulatory tender

Travel + Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide.

The **Senior Product Manager** will provide strategic leadership and direction for product initiatives within the organization. This role involves defining product vision and strategy, prioritizing features based on market analysis, and mentoring junior team members. The Senior Technical Product Manager acts as a technical subject matter expert, driving product innovation and optimizing performance metrics to achieve business objectives.  
  
**How You'll Shine:**

* Project Leadership: Provide strategic leadership and direction for product initiatives. Ensure alignment between product roadmap and organizational goals.
* Feature Development: Define and prioritize product features to deliver maximum value to customers. Drive innovation and continuous improvement in product features and functionality.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across the organization. Advocate for the needs of customers and stakeholders in decision-making processes.
* Requirements & User Stories: Define and refine product requirements based on market feedback and data analysis. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between requirements and user needs.
* Issue Management: Identify and mitigate project risks and issues to ensure successful delivery. Implement processes and tools to streamline issue resolution and decision-making.
* Technical Aptitude: Act as a technical subject matter expert within the organization. Provide guidance on technical architecture, design, and implementation.
* Metrics / Analytics: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of product initiatives. Analyze metrics and data to track product performance and user engagement. Utilize data-driven insights to optimize product features and functionality.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Limited travel throughout the year up to 15%. Occasional travel to meet with stakeholders, participate in team onsite meetings, perform usability testing, attend vendor meetings or conferences may be required.

**What You'll Bring:**

* BA/BS Marketing, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Preference to MBA and/or equivalent work experience.
* Certified SCRUM Product Owner Certification a plus but not required.
* Deep understanding of and experience in product management principles and best practices in hospitality, eCommerce and/or Information Technology.
* Visionary leadership to drive product initiatives and achieve business objectives.
* Demonstrated success managing web and mobile projects that require in-depth partnership with IT/technical counterparts and integration with back-end systems/data.
* Strong communication skills to effectively articulate product vision and strategy to executive stakeholders.
* Innovative thinking to drive product innovation and differentiation.
* Change management expertise to navigate organizational transitions and drive successful change initiatives.
* Strong decision-making skills to address complex challenges and make informed judgments.
* Ability to build and maintain relationships with executive stakeholders and key partners.
* Strategic planning skills to define and execute product strategies aligned with organizational goals.
* Performance management skills to set clear goals, track progress, and drive accountability.
* Deep understanding of business dynamics, market trends, and customer needs.

jobs.desc:
We're the studio behind the artist BREAKFAST. We design and build his robotic sculptures for the Venice Biennale, Rockefeller Center, the Fontainebleau in Las Vegas, Tiffany & Co. in New York, Dubai and Seoul, and private collections around the world. The largest is the world's largest kinetic sculpture: 53 feet wide, nearly 3,000 motorized tiles driven by live wind and tide data, aboard a Royal Caribbean cruise ship. No screens, no projectors. Each piece is hundreds to thousands of motors on an RS-485 bus under a Linux host, built to run for a decade with nobody watching it, and every board, line of firmware and bracket is designed and built by 17 people in our Brooklyn studio. See them move: https://theartistbreakfast.com/works
Senior Technical Program Manager: the artist's person on the ground with a six-person senior design and engineering team. You own every schedule in Asana, pressure-test estimates, run the weekly rhythm, flag slips the day you know, and deal with clients through install. Hardware+software TPM or producer background (robotics, consumer hardware, instruments), 8–12 years, fluent across at least two of mech/EE/firmware/software/ID. $150–200k base + profit share.
Senior Electrical & Firmware Engineer: own the electronics end to end. KiCad schematic→layout→revision, stepper/BLDC drive tuning, RS-485/Ethernet bus architecture, embedded C, production test fixtures, field-failure analysis. 10+ years shipping electronics you personally owned; real motor control; power/EMI/thermal; prototype→CM. $140–200k base + profit share.
No art background needed. We care whether you're sharp, can own a thing alone, and write plainly.

jobs.desc:
**About Foodsmart**:

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  

**About the Role:**

Reporting to our Chief Product Officer, this Senior Product Manager will be responsible for driving Foodsmart’s member activation. Every outcome we deliver for our members and clients starts with that first visit. You will own the funnel from first outreach to first visit, including the messaging, the channels, and the incentive structure that motivate members to show up.

Your customers are our members and our clients, who depend on us to turn eligible lives into engaged ones. You’ll lead a cross-functional pod to build out the systems and capabilities to achieve this goal and will work closely with Marketing, Data, and Partnerships to find what moves members from “eligible” to “booked” to “showed up,” and to do it at a cost that scales. This role is ideal for a product manager who is as comfortable in a funnel dashboard and an experiment readout as they are in the details of a text-message delivery issue or a broken scheduling flow.

**Tabs is the AI Operating System for Revenue, built for modern finance and accounting teams.** It combines deep revenue and accounting expertise with the agents and applications needed to run revenue work end to end. Tabs understands customer and contract context, applies accounting logic, and executes critical workflows with built in controls, auditability, and human oversight. With Tabs, finance teams can move from manually managing revenue workflows to directing outcomes while the system executes the work.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Revenue at Tabs: the system that turns performance obligations and usage data into recognized revenue a finance team can close the month on and an auditor can sign off on.

Audit-defensible revenue recognition is core to what Tabs does. You'll own the recognition engine across methods, the ASC 606 treatment that drives it (SSP allocation, variable consideration, contract modifications), and the audit trail and controls that make the numbers defensible. You'll report to the Director of Product and work every day with engineering, Solutions, and the finance teams who use Tabs.

**Why this role exists:** most revenue software is built by people who have never had to defend a number at close. We want someone who has, and who has also built software with engineers.

### **How We Work**

As Senior Product Manager, In-Vehicle Setup Experience, you will own the in-vehicle product experience and roadmap for setup and onboarding. You will translate customer needs, business objectives, technical constraints, and vehicle-program timing into a clear product strategy and prioritized set of outcomes.

  

You will help create a day 0 through n experiences that are welcoming, relevant, easy to understand, and valuable without delaying drive readiness. You will also establish the operating model and partnerships needed to make the experience consistent across in-vehicle, mobile, and web surfaces.

  

You will lead the product vision, strategy, and execution for GM’s in-vehicle setup experience—the customer’s first guided interaction with the vehicle. This role will make setup intuitive, personalized, and reliable by shaping the in-vehicle journey across account association, sign-in, pairing, profile setup, personalization, feature discovery, and drive readiness.

  

You will work closely with mobile, web, design, personalization, program management, legal, and privacy teams to deliver a cohesive setup journey across touch points. * Own the in-vehicle setup journey from vehicle association and sign-in through profile creation, pairing, feature configuration, and completion or deferment.

------------------

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. This seat owns product judgment for Single Brain and the API Gateway: which metrics matter, what is blocking them, and what engineering should build next.

Engineering owns **how** we build. You own **what** we build and **why**.

You report to the CTO. You work daily with a ~6-person engineering team. You do **not** manage that team as a people manager; you create clarity so their effort lands on the highest-leverage outcomes.

* Run strong weekly sprint kickoffs so the team leaves knowing: what metric are we moving, what are we doing to move it, and how will we know it worked.
* Own customer discovery — talk to customers often; separate loud requests from high-leverage opportunities.

* **By day 90:** prioritized roadmap tied to measurable outcomes; multiple complete build measure iterate cycles; measurable improvement in at least one meaningful product metric. Failure = features still shipping without hypotheses, instrumentation, or post-launch learning.
* **By 6–12 months:** durable product OS (Metric Diagnosis Hypothesis Build Measure Learn Iterate); customer discovery and post-launch measurement are standard; CTO is no longer the primary person deciding what engineering builds next; key product/business metrics improved materially.

**Evidence we want to see**
---------------------------

* Experience owning a technical software product (APIs, integrations, auth, data fluency).

* Sprint leadership / prioritization with engineering teams.
* Product analytics and instrumentation ownership (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar).

* Ideal: early-stage / growth-stage; developer tools, API, infrastructure, or AI products.

-------------------------

Not a project manager, not a backlog clerk, not “collect feature requests,” not “feature shipped = success,” not waiting for the CTO to dictate the roadmap.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a customer-focused, data-driven Senior Product Manager to shape product direction and lead high-impact SaaS initiatives that deliver measurable value for dealerships, their consumers, and our business.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned, technically grounded product manager who balances customer needs, technical feasibility, and business priorities, and who uses AI as a core part of how they work every day. They prototype to validate ideas while collaborating with UX and engineering teams, have sound judgment about where AI belongs in the product, and help peers build the same fluency.

**What You’ll Do**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Partner with Product leadership to shape the roadmap around company goals and customer needs.
* Use market trends, competitive insights, customer research, and product data to drive feature prioritization.
* Balance short-term delivery with long-term platform scalability and product vision.
* Lead initiatives that improve customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, and revenue.

**AI-Assisted Product Development**

* Build and test working prototypes to validate concepts with dealers and internal stakeholders.
* Use AI to accelerate research synthesis, competitive analysis, requirements drafting, and documentation.
* Define, scope, and measure AI-powered product capabilities, including success criteria, evaluation approaches, accuracy and reliability thresholds, and cost.
* Define requirements for how DealerOn products connect with AI through protocols such as MCP (Model Context Protocol), partnering with Engineering to determine which data and capabilities to expose to end users and agents.
* Assess where AI creates real value for dealers and shoppers, and where it introduces risk, before recommending it for the roadmap.

**Product Delivery**

* Lead collaboration across Engineering, UX, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Operations from concept through launch.
* Write clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
* Facilitate backlog refinement, release planning, and release readiness.
* Engage with engineering team as a technical peer, weighing performance and implementation trade-offs early so they shape the solution.
* Drive launches through validation, stakeholder communication, enablement, and post-release analysis.
* Define success metrics, instrumentation, and KPI tracking with Engineering and Data teams, and monitor adoption, engagement, conversion, and retention to find improvement opportunities.

**Customer Discovery**

* Collaborate with UX team for product discovery through customer interviews, workflow analysis, usability testing, and feedback synthesis.
* Build deep knowledge of dealership operations, automotive retail workflows, digital marketing, and agency workflows.
* Translate qualitative and quantitative research into unmet needs, workflow improvements, and scalable product opportunities.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Earning trust across Product, Engineering, UX, and operational teams.
* Making decisions that reflect strong customer empathy and measurable business impact.
* Shortening the path from idea to validated concept by using AI tools to test with stakeholders early.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional exp

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

------------------

* **Platform Vision:** Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.

* **Pricing & Packaging Delivery:** Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.
* **Metering & Usage Visibility:** Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.
* **Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle:** Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.

jobs.desc:
**Senior Product Manager**

Location: New York City | In-office

**The Mission**
===============

*“Leading healthcare into the agentic era.”*

Every day, patients call their clinic to schedule an appointment, ask a question, or request a prescription refill. Behind each conversation is a busy healthcare team coordinating people, information, and systems.

Taxo builds Voice AI agents that take on this administrative work. Our agents connect with EHR and practice management systems to help teams handle patient intake, complex scheduling, and refill requests, with reliable workflows and clear handoffs to people.

**The Opportunity: Turn Clinical Expertise into Product**
=========================================================

As our Senior Product Manager, you’ll bring deep clinical and EHR knowledge into the decisions that shape Taxo. You’ll understand how care teams actually work, identify where automation can help, and turn that insight into products engineers can build and customers can use. This role is for someone who can move comfortably between a clinical workflow, an EHR integration, and a product decision.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* **Get Close to the Workflow:** Spend time with clinicians, practice teams, and healthcare operators to understand their workflows, bottlenecks, and exceptions.
* **Own Product Decisions:** Own product discovery, roadmap priorities, requirements, and acceptance criteria for AI-powered administrative workflows.
* **Turn Complexity into Clarity:** Translate complex clinical and operational processes into clear product requirements and release plans, with measurable acceptance criteria for engineering and quality teams to validate.
* **Connect the EHR:** Work closely with engineering on EHR integrations, data flows, workflow dependencies, and human handoffs.
* **Measure Real Outcomes:** Define success measures for adoption, task completion, reliability, and time saved, then use evidence to guide iteration.
* **Learn from Deployment:** Turn clinic rollout feedback into reusable product improvements. Partner with the implementation team, which owns customer-specific rollout plans, training, user acceptance testing coordination, and go-live readiness.

**Who You Are**
===============

* **The Healthcare Expert:** Deep, firsthand knowledge of clinical workflows and day-to-day EHR use, demonstrated through healthcare software you have shipped with clinicians and practice teams.
* **The Product Builder:** Experience delivering healthcare software from discovery through adoption, with concrete examples of workflow exceptions you addressed, integration tradeoffs you made, and measurable adoption or operational outcomes.
* **The Translator:** The ability to map complex workflows, identify exceptions, and explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical colleagues.
* **The Systems Thinker:** Practical understanding of EHR capabilities, integration constraints, data quality, and patient privacy, grounded in product decisions you have made.
* **The Decision Maker:** Strong prioritization and analytical skills, with a track record of using customer feedback and product data to make decisions.
* **The Owner:** Comfort working closely with engineers and taking ownership of the details needed to get a product into use.
* **Bonus:** A clinical, clinical informatics, or healthcare operations background; hands-on EHR implementation or integration experience; familiarity with HL7/FHIR, conversational AI, or workflow automation.

**Why Taxo**
============

Healthcare teams should be able to spend more time on patients and less time on administration. Help us build the products and company that make that possible.

* **Clinical Knowledge That Counts:** Use your healthcare experience to shape real product decisions and workflows.
* **AI with a Clear Purpose:** Focus on where automation can reduce work while preserving reliability and human oversight.
* **Ownership from Discovery to Adoption:**

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Reporting & Analytics
jobs.desc:
**About RocketRez:**  
RocketRez is the revenue maximization platform behind boat tours, theme parks, zoos, and other attractions and experience operators. Operators run their businesses on us: ticketing, capacity, memberships, point of sale, web stores, and the data that tells them how how to grow their business.
  
  
**The role:**  
Operators ask us questions every day. How did yesterday go? Which channel actually converts? Did the new pricing pay off, or did it just move demand around? Your job is to turn those questions into data, reports, and visuals that answer them clearly and lead to a revenue maximizing decision.
  
**You'll own Reporting & Analytics end to end:** the reports, dashboards, and insights operators use to run their business, from the general manager checking yesterday's attendance to the finance lead reconciling a month of revenue across channels, and the data models and metric definitions behind them. You'll own its roadmap, its customers, and the case for where engineering time goes. Your job is to prove that reporting can be the front door to RocketRez: where operators start their day, and what moves them to act. You'll be measured on usage, and on the revenue operators earn from the decisions reporting drives.
  
  
**What we're building:**  
Operators move more of their business onto RocketRez when they trust us with their busiest day, and that trust depends on the numbers. If the reporting is wrong, late, or confusing, nothing else we build gets believed.
  
First, reporting operators trust. Core reporting on par with the best in hospitality.
  
Next, a revenue engine. Operators set revenue targets and campaigns, track their pace against them and against past seasons, and get clear options when they fall behind.
  
Then, automated revenue management. Automation keeps tracking and planning running without the operator asking. It recommends actions grounded in the operator's own history and in how similar operators are performing, and makes acting on them a single click. Season pass sales dipping? Here are three options based on this season and the last two.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  
Understand the question• Spend real time with operators across roles, from general managers and finance leads to marketers and front-gate supervisors. Learn the decisions they make and the questions they need answered to make them.
  

* Design reporting that leads to a decision. Every report should make clear what it means and what to do next.

Data fluency• Prototype with real data. Write your own SQL to mock up a report or metric and put it in front of operators before engineering builds it.
  

* Own the metric definitions the platform runs on: revenue, attendance, capacity utilization, and conversion mean the same thing in every report, in every domain.
* Apply statistical judgment: seasonality, small samples, cohorts, fair comparisons, and forecasting.
* Choose the right visual for the question, and hold a high bar for clarity, accuracy, and honest scales.
* Treat data quality as product quality.
* Work with other domains so new products capture the data reporting needs before they ship.

**Strategy and roadmap• Own the roadmap:** sizing, sequencing, and what gets cut.
  

* Shape how automation and AI turn insights into recommended actions: which recommendations are trustworthy, when a human should decide, and the guardrails around both.
* Define how cross-operator benchmarks work: peer sets, minimum sample sizes, and anonymization that operators trust enough to opt into.
* Make the build, buy, and partner calls on analytics tooling, and know the market well enough to say which gaps are worth closing.

**What we look for:**  
The trait we care about most is adaptability. The tools and methods of product management are changing, so we hire people who have already reinvented how they work on their own initiative and will do it again.
  

* You've rebuilt how you work without being told to, including becoming AI-na

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

* Inclusive – we succeed together

* Future Focused – we accelerate change

**Job Description**

To support the development of our Lens data analytics platform, we are looking for a dynamic Senior Product Manager to be an integral part of our Commodities Product team covering Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals and Metals & Mining.

*Knowledge & experience*

* Experienced Product Manager, or Analyst looking to expand their role into the Product Management space
* Experience with the product development cycle including agile software development (Scrum/Kanban), design process, and instrumenting analytics.
* Basic industry knowledge and strong interest on one or multiple sectors covered in our portfolio (Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals, Metals & Mining), understanding of the major players, market conditions, and industry standards. Intellectual curiosity for industry is a must.
* Experience working on data migrations projects, and using AI in product development is a strong plus.
* Good oral and written communication skills
* Key tools that we use are JIRA, Productboard and Amplitude. Our tech stack is mainly on AWS and Snowflake.

*Impact on the team*

* Act as the day-to-day point person for the cross-functional team, providing a seamless bridge between Research Analysts, Data teams, UX, and Engineering to identify solutions that work within a set of defined constraints and align to the broader business strategy and achieve customer-focused results.
* Align understanding by defining user requirements with clear acceptance criteria across multiple features
* Assist in documentation and testing of given solutions to ensure fit for customers

*Stakeholder & client relationships*

* Collaborate with Marketing and Sales to enable go-to-market effort

jobs.desc:
Seven Starling is revolutionizing women's behavioral health through our clinically-validated virtual care platform. As a venture-backed, rapidly scaling startup at the forefront of maternal healthcare innovation, we've developed a groundbreaking clinical model that combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat perinatal mood disorders. Our approach delivers exceptional results — 90% of patients experience clinically significant symptom improvement.

We've established strategic partnerships with leading health plans including UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna, plus a growing network of OBGYN clinics nationwide, positioning us for accelerated growth in the $50B+ women's behavioral health market.

### **About the role**

We’re hiring for a **Senior Product Manager** — a strategic, execution-minded builder who will be a core member of our Product team. This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the VP of Product and partnering closely with the engineering team and cross-functional roles to design and scale the systems and experiences that power our precision mental health care model.

The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience in product management and thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. We're looking for a mission-driven and resourceful self-starter who excels at turning complex problems into clear, scalable solutions. You should be a strong communicator, deeply curious about user needs, and comfortable experimenting with AI tools to build systems and documentation from the ground up. Experience in digital health and early stage startup environments is strongly preferred.

If you're an experienced product professional with a strong commitment to our mission, we want to hear from you. Join us in paving the way for expanded access to high-quality women's mental healthcare!

### **What you'll do**

* **Own our end-to-end product development process**, from user research and scoping to execution, QA, and post-launch measurement and iteration
* **Conduct deep user research** with patients, clinicians, referring providers, and internal team members to understand their pain points and needs
* **Develop clear, actionable PRDs and prototypes** to define product specs and workflows that meet the needs of cross-functional stakeholders and set clear objectives for the engineering team to execute on
* **Lead product launches,** partnering closely with engineering, operations, and clinical leads on training, documentation, and process updates to ensure seamless rollout and adoption of new products and tools

* **Own the tools that run our patient journey,** from third-party survey and communication platforms, to EHR templates and the automations tied to scheduling, screening, and care coordination

* **Use AI tools** to accelerate your own work and continuously innovate on how we build as a team, from research and documentation to prototyping and design

* **Define and monitor success metrics** for core tools and services that we build, including data analysis, dashboard creation, and company-wide impact reporting

* **Partner with our VP of Product and other senior leaders** to inform roadmap planning and strategic prioritization

### **Who you are**

* You are a **senior-level individual contributor (IC)** with 5+ years of experience in product management, ideally with a significant portion of that time in digital health
* You have a track record of **owning complex, cross-functional products** from problem definition to launch
* You’re comfortable with **ambiguous, early-stage environments**, and excited to be a part of a small team developing product strategy, process, and tools
* You’re both **empathetic and systems-oriented** — equally energized by speaking with users and by designing scalable, backend workflows

* You actively **use AI tools to move faster** — you’ve used agentic tools to actually build or prototype, not just ask questions

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
### **Who We Are**

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform and an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 400 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an equal-opportunity employer, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce. At Cobalt, we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations to continue to nurture our unique, rich, diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

**Description**

Modern software demands continuous security validation. Cobalt is pioneering the evolution beyond legacy, point-in-time PTaaS through our Autonomous and Continuous pentesting platform-providing continuous, scalable, and AI-driven security coverage across enterprise environments.

In the role of **Senior Technical Product Manager**, you will shape the strategic product vision, steer live initiatives, and spearhead 0-to-1 feature development to drive business ROI across Cobalt's Autonomous and Continuous Pentesting portfolio. You will conduct deep product discovery, instill scalable PM leadership practices, and redefine how continuous, autonomous offensive security is delivered to modern enterprises.

You will combine strong business acumen with technical rigor, driving clear feature ownership from discovery to delivery. Operating as a proactive cross-functional leader, you will challenge existing processes and communicate transparently to ensure our continuous pentesting platform solves critical customer security problems with measurable impact.

**What You Would Do**

As a member of a growing team of product managers your responsibilities include:

* **Strategic PM Leadership & Business ROI:** Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for the Autonomous and Continuous pentesting portfolio. Align feature scope directly with customer value and measurable business outcomes, tracking clear adoption and retention metrics.
* **Product Discovery Excellence:** Lead continuous customer discovery and market validation to identify high-impact customer problems in the continuous security testing space. Translate complex user needs into actionable, validated product requirements.
* **End-to-End Feature Ownership:** Take full operational ownership of product features across the entire lifecycle—from initial ideation and specification to execution, deployment, and post-launch evaluation.
* **Proactive Leadership & Process Innovation:** Actively challenge inefficient workflows, implement scalable product processes, and foster high alignment across engineering, design, marketing, and executive stakeholders.
* **Transparent & Structured Communication:** Maintain standard executive-level visibility into roadmap progress, product decisions, and operational metrics through regular updates and clear artifact documentation.
* **Domain Expertise in Autonomous Security:** Serve as the internal subject matter expert on continuous vulnerability management, AI-driven offensive security techniques, and automated pentesting workflows.
* **Data-Driven Performance Management:** Define and monitor rigorous success criteria, evaluating product performance against strategic business metrics and customer satisfaction outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Invoicing
jobs.desc:
Every business needs to get paid. For many of the startups and small businesses that bank with Mercury, that starts with sending an invoice. The process has to be effortless. A polished, professional invoice should take seconds to create. Customers should be able to pay easily. Once the payment arrives, it should match itself to the right invoice without anyone lifting a finger.

Mercury Invoicing is a fast-growing product serving customers across Technology, Professional Services, Real Estate, and more. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to take a product that already works and make it even more powerful.

You’ll own the full Invoicing experience: the dashboard where businesses track what they’re owed, the builder where they create invoices, and the payer experience on the other side. You’ll work closely with the PM who built Invoicing from scratch and now leads adjacent efforts. Together, you’ll decide how Invoicing grows to meet more complex customer needs without losing the simplicity that made customers choose it in the first place.

* *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.*

### **What you’ll do:**

* Own the roadmap for Mercury Invoicing across every surface: the dashboard, the builder and the payer experience
* Talk to customers and prospects, and turn what you hear into clear next steps
* Take on a full backlog of work we already know customers need: accounting integrations, invoice templates, credits and credit memos, promos and coupons .. the list goes on
* Keep the product simple while making it more powerful, so it grows with customers as their businesses scale
* Find where AI can make getting paid meaningfully better, without chasing hype
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design and Data Science, as well as Product Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Risk and other product teams like Mercury Books
* Grow the business, measured by Invoicing’s active users, new feature adoption, and customer retention

### **What you bring:**

* 5+ years of product management experience building and shipping products, ideally ones where money moves and mistakes are costly
* Strong product judgment: you can take a full backlog, decide what matters most and explain why
* A passion for talking to customers, and a record of turning their feedback into products they love
* Close attention to detail. Invoices are money, and small details matter to the businesses sending them and to the people paying them.
* High agency and comfort owning a product end to end, from problem definition to launch and iteration
* Strong partnership with engineering and design, and the ability to align many cross-functional stakeholders behind one plan
* The ability to learn a new domain quickly

### **It would be particularly useful if you have:**

* Experience at a company that serves startups and/or small businesses
* Built products in invoicing, accounts receivable, billing or payments
* Experience with accounting integrations such as QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite

You don’t need prior invoicing or AR experience to succeed in this role. We care more about your customer instincts, product judgment and ability to learn the domain quickly.

While formal on-the-job experience with AI is a plus, we highly value candidates who have proactively incorporated AI into their personal projects, explored AI-driven development environments (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot), or built automations using AI agents. Show us how you've used AI to learn, build, and solve problems beyond basic text generation.

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About This Role:

Every month, hundreds of thousands of patients and providers interact with Headway's support systems. Today, most interactions are handled by human agents working across disconnected tools. We believe CX is a product, not just a department — and the right product leader can transform how Headway supports its customers while dramatically improving both satisfaction and cost efficiency.

As Director of Product for CX, you will build Headway's CX product function from the ground up. You'll own the product vision and strategy for how patients and providers get help — from AI-powered self-resolution to context-aware agent tooling to the feedback loops that connect support insights back to the product.

You will:

  • Define the vision and strategy for Headway's CX product — spanning AI-powered resolution, agent tooling, proactive engagement, channel strategy, knowledge systems, and the feedback loops that connect support insights back to the product.
  • Build and lead a team of product managers focused on reducing cost-to-serve while increasing resolution quality and customer satisfaction.
  • Own the AI resolution layer — build the agentic workflows and API integrations that enable the AI agent to actually resolve problems, not just answer questions. Define the autonomy framework: what AI handles without human involvement, what needs guardrails, and what requires a human.
  • Build proactive engagement — systems that contact customers before they discover problems. Shift Headway's CX from reactive to proactive.
  • Launch and unify all contact channels — email, text, and voice — with intelligent routing that delivers differentiated experiences based on customer context, value, and issue type.
  • Own the knowledge and quality layer — machine-readable SOPs, AI evaluation frameworks and crisis escalation pathways.
  • Partner deeply with CX Operations to build agent tooling that makes human agents dramatically more effective — AI copilot, full journey context, auto-generated summaries.
  • Close the feedback loop: build the system that identifies the highest-impact product defects driving support volume and surfaces them to insurance platform teams for upstream fixes.
  • Establish measurement frameworks that connect CX product investments to business outcomes..

You'd Be a Great Fit If...

  • You are a product leader with 8+ years of experience, including at least 3 years managing PMs, with a track record of building CX/support products at scale.
  • You have a strong point of view on how AI will transform customer support — and you've shipped AI-powered CX products.
