jobs.title: Head of Product @ Koast.ai
jobs.desc:
Head of Product | Contract, 20 hrs/week to start, growing into full-time | Remote (US overlapping hours) | Reports to the CEO

The short version

Koast is the AI operating layer for teams that run Meta ads at volume. Agencies, in-house media buying teams, and enterprise buyers managing 10+ ad accounts and launching 50+ ads a week use Koast to launch faster, automate optimizations off real attribution data, and see every account from one hub. The Koast Agent is the next layer: an AI that reads the account, spots what matters, and acts inside guardrails.

We are a small team shipping fast. The product is live, customers are paying, a Whop partnership just onboarded a wave of new users, and the Agent build is underway. What we do not have is one person who owns the product end to end: what gets built, why, in what order, and whether it actually landed.

That is this role. It starts at 20 hours a week on contract. If you are the right person, it becomes the full-time product seat at Koast.

What you will own

Discovery that finds the real problem. You will sit in on enterprise sales calls and onboarding sessions, run discovery with agencies and media buying teams, and figure out what they are actually trying to get done versus what they say they want. Every feature request gets mapped to a job: launching smoother, getting their team in, getting tasks done, keeping users active and growing spend inside Koast. If it does not serve a job, it does not get built.

Specs that engineering can execute without a meeting. We run a lean engineering team plus an AI-assisted dev pipeline. That only works when the ticket is unambiguous. You will write PRDs and Shortcut tickets that define the behavior, the edge cases, the data dependencies (Meta API limits, Hyros and Cometly attribution feeds, Whop account provisioning), and the acceptance criteria. If an engineer or an agent has to guess, the spec was not done.

The queue, and what is missing from it. You own the Up Next column. You will keep engineering fed so they are never blocked, and you will keep a standing view of what is discussed in Slack, support, and QA that does not yet have a ticket. Gaps are your problem before they become customer problems.

Evidence over opinion. PostHog, Intercom, session replays, rage clicks, support threads. You will run the user-behavior audit, know where people drop off in launching, and bring numbers to every prioritization argument, including the ones with the CEO.

Delivery from spec to shipped. Governance, milestones, release notes, and the customer conversation after it ships. When something breaks or slips, you are the one who says so early, not the one who explains it after.

Technical judgement in a non-deterministic product. The Koast Agent makes decisions off data that is noisy, seasonal, and shaped by Meta's learning phase. You will make product calls that respect that: what the Agent is allowed to do, what it must never do, how we measure whether an automated action was correct. Guardrails are infrastructure here, not UI. You need to understand why.

What you will do week to week

  • Run discovery sessions with prospects and customers and turn them into scoped, execution-ready PRDs.
  • Surface technical risk early: undocumented API behavior, missing data, an assumption that will not survive a real ad account.
  • Write and groom Shortcut tickets with enough detail for an engineer or Claude Code to ship without a follow-up question.
  • Partner with engineering on feasibility, sequencing, and cutting scope to what ships this week.
  • Own success metrics per feature and report on them after launch, n

jobs.desc:
**Director, Product Management (PrintOps)**  
**Pharos | US Remote**

  
  
*Here's what you'd actually be stepping into: an established product, two new markets it hasn't reached yet, and no one left who can tell you why it behaves the way it does. Some people need that explanation handed to them. Others go dig it up themselves. This role is for the second kind.*

### About Pharos

Pharos Systems International is the leader in PrintOps, the integrated, user-centric, and cloud-native approach to managing printing and the infrastructure and operations behind it. Pharos' modern print management software empowers enterprises to reduce costs, strengthen security, and support today's hybrid workforce with simple, reliable, and scalable printing solutions. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including many of the world's largest Fortune 500 companies, Pharos has helped eliminate print servers, cut millions in print-related spend, and accelerate the transition to cloud-based infrastructure. Headquartered in Rochester, NY, Pharos has been delivering innovative print management solutions and measurable ROI since 1992.  
  
Our flagship product already runs inside a large, established customer base, which means it carries real history, real workarounds, and a level of hidden complexity that isn't written down anywhere. We're also pushing it into new markets it hasn't served before, without losing the trust of the customers who already rely on it every day. That combination, protecting what works while extending what's possible, is exactly why this role exists.

### What This Role Is

This role owns the full product loop for one of Pharos's most established product areas: understanding how it actually works today, bringing its capabilities under control, deciding what to build and what to explicitly leave alone, and making sure Engineering and the rest of the company are working from the same understanding you are.  
  
You'll work directly with enterprise customers, including the conversations where the answer is no, and you'll set direction across customer commitments, technical constraints, and two new markets at once, without letting the loudest voice in the room decide the roadmap for you.  
  
You'll also use AI as a normal part of how you work: discovery, synthesis, competitive research, epic drafting, documentation, not as a novelty, but as how the work actually gets done, in a fast loop with Engineering that doesn't wait on oversized specs.

### What You Will Own

* The model of how this product actually works, and keeping it current as you learn more.
* A visible roadmap where every item has a reason, an owner, and a real answer for what Pharos is and isn't doing.
* The path from a raw signal (a support ticket, a sales request, a customer complaint) to a decision someone can act on.
* Direct conversations with enterprise customers, including the ones where the answer is no.
* The translation of product direction into work Engineering can actually build and verify against.
* Making sure Sales, Support, Customer Success, Services, and Marketing know what changed and why, not just that it changed.

### What a Strong Background Looks Like

* You've owned a mature, complicated product, one with real history, real workarounds, and a real customer base, not just a green-field build.
* You've sat across the table from enterprise customers directly: discovery calls, pilots, advisory relationships, the uncomfortable ones included.
* You've turned a messy customer or market need into something Engineering could actually build against, and stuck around to see what happened after.
* You've made a complex product simpler, more consistent, or easier to reason about, not just added more to it.
* You reach for AI as a normal part of how you think through a problem, not as a novelty.

**Not a good fit if…**

**Strong fit if…**

  

You're looking to build and lead a team starting now.  
You've only ever built new products from a blank sheet,

Tenna is searching for a Director of Product to translate our product vision and strategy into clear, actionable plans that drive execution across multiple product teams. This leader will manage and develop a global team while remaining closely involved in the day-to-day work required to deliver sophisticated B2B SaaS, mobile, and hardware-enabled products.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership to establish priorities, communicate progress, remove obstacles, and deliver products that solve meaningful problems for customers.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.desc:
**Type::** Full-time

**Location:** Remote, with a preference for candidates located in NY, TX, MD, or GA

**Compensation:** $140,000 - $180,000

**Job Level:** Director/VP (depending on experience)

**ABOUT LEMONTREE**
-------------------

There are more food pantries in the US than there are McDonalds, but most families facing hunger don't take that help. That's why we started Lemontree–because it makes no sense for our neighbors to go hungry when there's free food around the corner. We've helped one million households access the free food in their communities by bringing technology + empathy to the experience of food assistance. Learn more about us at https://www.foodhelpline.org/about.

### **Our Values**

**Service Over Self**

We put the mission — helping people find food — ahead of ego, credit, or agenda. That means caring for the people we serve and the team around us, and going the extra mile when it makes a real difference. We're here for the work itself and what it makes possible for others.

**Ownership**

We get shit done and we carry our piece so the whole team can move forward. When we make a mistake, we name it early and openly, because a problem we've owned out loud is one we can fix together. In a growing org, this kind of autonomy & accountability is how we do big things with a small team.

**Curiosity**  
We don't take anything for granted. We stay curious about our users and ourselves. We stay humble enough to accept that there's always room to improve. We stay ready to change course when the evidence points somewhere new. The plan we have today is a strong draft, but we'll always need to adapt to a changing world. We'd rather ask the better question and adjust than defend a stale answer.

**THE POSITION**
----------------

Lemontree is looking for a **Head of Product** **& Technology** that will partner with the Executive Director to own and evolve our platform strategy to scale our impact. Since 2020, we've grown from a simple helpline into a platform that serves thousands of families, partners, and volunteers daily. What we need now is someone who can shepherd us to the next level, bringing rigor and direction to how we evolve: sharper prioritization, better use of our data, and clearer decision-making & process around where we invest our resources. Every decision we make should align with our strategic anchors:

* User-centered

* Hospitality in every interaction

* Built for scale

This is a hands-on leadership role with high trust and high agency, reporting to the Executive Director. You'll be the person setting product direction and leading the charge to move it forward, partnering with an engineering agency on execution and collaborating closely across our broader Lemontree team. While product ownership is the focus, this is a multi-disciplinary position that combines product management, data analysis, and technical leadership to build toward stability *and* scalability. If you like operating with real autonomy and are motivated to take things from 1 100, this role will suit you.

### **What You'll Do**

Drive **technical leadership** that delivers a reliable, joyful, scalable user experience for neighbors looking for food assistance.

* Serve as a credible technical voice in conversations about architecture, tradeoffs, and feasibility.
* Direct our engineering agency, translating product priorities into well-scoped technical work and holding a high bar for what ships.
* Oversee third party services that support our product, including setting up integrations, managing billing, negotiating nonprofit discounts, etc.

Own a **product roadmap** that increases the breadth & depth of our impact, aligned with our organizational strategy.

* Partner with CEO & senior leadership to shape overall strategy & product direction. Rather than making every single product decision, you will own the process that helps those decisions happen with the right information, clear accountability, and strong follow-through.

That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. * Own the release governance path end to end, including the tradeoffs between developer velocity and auditability, and the gating model that makes those tradeoffs explicit rather than accidental.

jobs.desc:
Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

End users enjoy a seamless, zero-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and [solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

**The role**
------------

The Director of Product, Pay owns the product experience and technology-enabled workflows that move a purchase through payment, invoice processing, and reconciliation. You will lead product strategy, discovery, definition, delivery, instrumentation, and post-launch improvement for Pay, working with Engineering and Design and in close partnership with the Payments business leader and Finance.

This is an outcome-owning product leadership role, not a payments P&L or operational program-lead role. You will be measured on whether Pay products are reliable, faster to bring to market, and less costly to operate.

**What you will own**

### **Payment products and reliability**

* Define the customer and administrator experience for virtual cards and other supported payment methods, including controls, payment status, failures, disputes, and intervention paths.
* Own product requirements, instrumented quality, and the technical integration and viability assessment of payment rails and partners, with Engineering.
* Improve the reliability and operability of payment journeys; use production evidence and customer feedback to prioritize fixes.
* Work with the Payments business on partner performance and re-platform decisions.

### **AP automation and reconciliation**

* Own the product workflows for invoice capture, extraction, matching, exception resolution, and reconciliation against purchasing activity.
* Reduce manual handling and cost-to-serve through measurable improvements in accuracy, automation, and exception handling.
* Define the Pay-side data and workflow needed to reconcile into customer financial systems.
* Apply AI-assisted extraction, matching, or exception handling only where evaluation shows better accuracy, cost, or customer outcomes, with human oversight and auditability appropriate to the risk.

### **Credit and working-capital product**

* Own the decisioning-system product requirements, customer experience, and payment-rail implementation for approved credit or working-capital offerings.
* Translate the Payments business case and Finance's policy into a usable, instrumented product journey.

### **Strategy, prioritization, and delivery**

* Own Pay product discovery, definition, delivery, launch instrumentation, and post-launch product measurement, drawing on customer, market, field, and operating evidence.
* Build an evidence-backed product roadmap and business-case input for the CTO portfolio process.
* Within an approved and funded payments program, work with the Payments business on its commercial sequence and translate that sequence into feasible product plans. Changes that require additional capacity or displace other portfolio

jobs.title: Director of Product, Engagement
jobs.desc:
Stash exists to put a financial advisor in everyone's pocket: investing, banking, and personalized guidance in one app for everyday Americans to invest and save with confidence.

Stash is hiring a **Director of Product** to lead Engagement; the in-app experiences that help people decide what to invest in, how much to put in, and what to do next.

You will lead the product managers on Engagement, on web and mobile. You will be accountable for whether subscribers use the product and stay: product usage, recurring contributions, and retained paying subscribers. You will report to the Head of Product and partner as a peer with Design, Engineering, Marketing, Data, and Compliance.

This is a player/coach role that is best for someone that wants to manage and develop people while staying hands on. You'll set the strategy, manage 2-3 Product Managers, and lead by example as part of a team yourself.

**This position operates on a hybrid schedule, requiring you to be on-site in our New York office** **at least****three days per week to** **work with stakeholders and****foster team collaboration.**

**What you'll do:**

* Set multi-quarter strategy for Engagement: guidance, investing and banking surfaces, and the habits that keep subscribers active
* Hire, coach, and lead the Engagement product managers; set the bar for judgment, writing, and use of data
* Own the Engagement roadmap across web and mobile, and decide what gets capacity when the team is pulled in more than one direction
* Hold the team to outcomes: product usage, recurring engagement, and retained paying subscribers
* Partner with Marketing so lifecycle messaging and the in-app experience tell one story
* Run a rhythm of discovery, experimentation, and shipping inside regulatory guardrails
* Represent Engagement in leadership forums with a clear story and numbers
* Use AI in how you and your team do the work, and expect the same from the people you hire

**What we're looking for:**

* 10+ years in product management, including several years managing product managers
* Strong consumer app experience: you have owned a mobile and/or web product people use in daily life, and you can talk about user and business impact with numbers
* A track record on engagement, retention, or monetization, in addition to shipping new product
* You can set strategy and still get into the details when a decision depends on them
* Clear communication with executives, peers, and your team
* A strong partner to engineering, design, marketing, and data
* You use AI in your workflow today, or you are ready to adopt it here and with your team
* Strong experimentation practice and fluency with product analytics (Mixpanel, Looker, or similar)

**Gold Stars**

* Subscription or other recurring-revenue consumer business
* Fintech, investing, banking, or another regulated consumer product
* Products built around habits and automation

jobs.desc:
Clearwater Analytics is seeking a dynamic leader to strategically build and oversee our product and portfolio marketing function, with a focus on global and client expansion. We are looking for someone passionate about understanding client needs, delving into product details, and creating messaging that drives value-driven initiatives. This leadership role reports directly to the CMO and requires outstanding communication, leadership, and marketing skills. The successful candidate will work closely with colleagues across teams, including product, sales, partnerships, and more.

* Develop Strategic Narratives, Messaging, and Positioning: Craft and optimize positioning and messaging across various dimensions (market, company, platform, product, and competitive positioning) to empower sales teams, support successful product launches, and deploy through all market-facing communication touchpoints (website, sales messages, SDR, content, etc.).

**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Job Description: Director of Product Management – Open USD Compliance and Onboarding Feature Owner**

Visa’s Stablecoin team is building cutting-edge onchain infrastructure to change the way money moves. While onchain solutions began as niche and speculative, they are now transforming how value moves across the global financial ecosystem.

Visa is at the forefront of this transition. We are rapidly expanding our stablecoin and tokenized money infrastructure to enhance our network and develop solutions for partners around the world. Visa brings trust, scale, and security to the evolving onchain ecosystem, creating the opportunity for generational impact in payments and beyond.

We are seeking a **Director of Product Management – Open USD Compliance and Onboarding** to set the strategy and lead delivery of scalable capabilities for partner onboarding, Know Your Business (KYB), compliance, and partner data management. This leader will define the global product vision and operating model, establish roadmap priorities, and guide the development of workflows, platforms, controls, and automation required to expand Open USD responsibly across markets and partner segments.

This is a senior, highly cross-functional leadership role at the intersection of stablecoins, regulatory strategy, financial crime compliance, onboarding operations, data governance, and enterprise-scale financial infrastructure. The ideal candidate combines strategic product leadership with strong execution discipline, can influence executive stakeholders, and can translate complex global and local requirements into a cohesive platform strategy and measurable business outcomes.

In this role, you will lead across compliance, legal, risk, operations, engineering, data, sales, client-facing teams, and regional stakeholders to define and deliver the capabilities required to scale Open USD globally. You will own the compliance and onboarding product portfolio, including regional expansion of KYB and related controls based on local regulatory, licensing, data, documentation, and risk requirements. You will align global platform standards with market-specific needs while avoiding unnecessary fragmentation.

This role requires an enterprise product leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, make informed trade-offs across growth, risk, control, and client experience, and mobilize cross-functional teams to deliver capabilities that are controlled, auditable, scalable, and commercially practical. The Director will establish governance, communicate decisions and dependencies to senior leadership, and ensure the portfolio is positioned for sustainable global growth.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

The Colorado Benefits Eligibility and Enrollment Systems (CoBEES) is a cross-agency portfolio of information technology systems, subsystems, applications, interfaces, training, and communications managed and maintained by the State of Colorado to deliver access to public assistance and medical coverage programs for Coloradans. Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported.

We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes.

### **Come Build with Us**

We're a NYC-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We're an office-first company that values in-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. If that sounds like your kind of place, we think you'll love it here.

### **The Opportunity**

Courier Health is at an inflection point. We exist to get patients faster, better access to life-saving therapies, and product helps to shape decisions related to which patients we reach next and how soon.

As Director of Product, you will lead a team of product managers covering the full platform, reporting directly to the CEO. You will also keep a hand in the work running discovery, writing the spec, making the call — on the bets that matter most.

The roadmap here is not handed down. You will decide what we build, in what order, and what we deliberately don't do, in a market where the right answer is rarely obvious and the stakes are patients starting therapy. If you have led product teams inside someone else's operating model and want to define your own, this is the seat.

### **What You'll Build**

**A product team that makes its own calls.** You will coach to a standard in weekly one on ones and roadmap reviews, raise the bar on writing and discovery, and give your PMs enough room to be wrong and get better. The goal is a team that can size a bet and defend it without you in the room.

**A roadmap the whole company can bet on.** Sales, implementation, and engineering all plan against what product says is coming. You will set the sequencing across a growing customer base, make the tradeoffs between what one strategic client needs and what the platform needs, and say no clearly enough that people trust the yes. Commitments hold, and when they change, everyone knows why in time to act.

**Discovery grounded in how patients actually get to therapy.** Our users are the people running patient support programs, field teams, and hub operations. You will get your team in front of them, translate what you hear into product, and build the customer and market fluency that makes our roadmap hard to copy. Strong opinions are welcome here. Strong opinions without customer contact are not.

* 5+ years managing product managers. You have hired, coached, and given hard feedback that made someone better.
* Proven ownership of a roadmap end to end from customer discovery and strategy through launch and measured outcomes, not just execution against someone else's plan.
* Strong technical fluency. You can work through data models, API integrations, and architectural tradeoffs with engineers and hold your own. Coding is not required. Depth is.
* Excellent judgment under ambiguity. You can make a call with incomplete information, explain the reasoning, and change course without drama when the evidence shifts.
* Exceptional written communication. You think in documents, and your specs make the decision obvious.
* Comfortable working directly with senior customer stakeholders, including the conversations nobody wants to have.
* Experience building process where none existed, and the restraint to keep it minimal.

jobs.desc:
**Director of Product — SafeSend (Gather & Deliver)**

**Job Description:**

Accounting firms are reinventing how they prepare tax returns, and their clients, taxpayers expect a simple, secure, digital way to hand over documents and get a finished return. Firms expect everything in between to be faster, more automated, and connected to the tools they already run. SafeSend is where that happens: the taxpayer-facing perimeter and engine of Tax Workflow for accounting firm clients, the surface taxpayers touch, and, through its APIs, the engine firms build their own workflows on.

As Director of Product for SafeSend, you will own that surface and lead its evolution into an AI-driven, agentic gather-prepare-deliver experience on Thomson Reuters’ CoCounsel platform and open it up so firms and partners can build on it.

**The opportunity:**

* Firms are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
* Taxpayers expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive their return.
* Document data extraction is going AI-native; firms want agentic preparation and review and are adopting it now.
* Firms increasingly want to build on open APIs so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
SafeSend sits at the center of all four. This is a build-and-converge mandate — shaping a market-defining product, not maintaining a mature one.  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deliver SafeSend. Own the SafeSend portfolio end to end — Gather, Organizers, e-Sign, Delivery, Returns and Extensions — season over season, at the reliability and scale that tax-filing peaks demand.
* Converge SafeSend and TaxCaddy. Bring the best of SafeSend and TaxCaddy together into one Gather & Deliver experience for every firm and taxpayer[CH1]
* Componentize the portfolio. Turn each part of SafeSend into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the gather – prepare – deliver flow and used across the broader CoCounsel platform, rather than locked inside a single app.
* Enable expanded SafeSend access via APIs and orchestration. Expand the SafeSend API surface — open APIs, events and integrations — as a first-class capability, so firms and partners embed SafeSend in their own portals and workflows and keep their tools, data and reporting connected, with orchestration so AI agents and partner systems can coordinate gather and delivery programmatically.
Deliver agentic Gather & Deliver through CoCounsel. Bring agentic Gather — and AI-driven extraction, preparation and review — into the SafeSend experience on the CoCounsel platform, so more of the work shifts from staff to the platform while the firm stays in control.  

**What success looks like:**

* Firms experience one connected Gather & Deliver workflow, whatever ecosystem they run today.
* The SafeSend API is something firms and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.
* Firms reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through SafeSend, season over season.
Taxpayers get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience — and firms see measurably less manual work.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years in product management, including leading a product line at scale as a Director or senior PM.
* Experience building and productizing platform, API or developer-facing products — not only features on top of them.
* A track record of converging or migrating products without disrupting existing customers.
* Fluency with AI-native products (data extraction, agents, orchestration) and comfort partnering with a platform team.
* Strong systems thinking — able to see a portfolio as composable components rather than a monolith.
* Experience in the tax & accounting workflow space strongly preferred
Strong stakeholder management and a proven record of building high-performing teams  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Background in tax & accounting, fintech, or document / data-pro

KeepTruckin builds technology using the latest advancements in AI and computer vision to improve the safety and efficiency of businesses with vehicles. Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery... the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are...

When we say, "the stuff dreams are made of," we're not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD's vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what's next...

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Avalanche is a Warner Bros. Games studio located in downtown Salt Lake City nestled against the backdrop of the beautiful Wasatch Mountains. We've been in the video game business since 1995, creating interactive experiences for fans of the world's largest franchises. Join the team behind the blockbuster open world, action RPG Hogwarts Legacy as we create what's next!

Avalanche, a division of WB Games Inc., is seeking an Advanced Product Manager to join our team of talented industry veterans working on a new online multiplayer RPG.

Your New Role

We're looking for an Advanced Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of player empathy and analytical rigor. You've shipped games and navigated the intensity of launch and/or found your rhythm in the ongoing discipline of live operations. You know your way around a telemetry pipeline as well as a product roadmap, and you're able to rally the cross-functional team around a product vision.

Your Role Accountabilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Partner with other disciplines to craft features across your area from concept through release and into post-launch iteration, owning outcomes at every stage
  • Turn high-level business strategy and player insights into clear, prioritized roadmaps for team collaboration
  • Partner with leadership to define short- and long-term product vision, articulating tradeoffs with confidence and clarity
  • Write sharp, thorough PRDs, feature specs, and briefs that empower the team for clear alignment

jobs.desc:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About this role:

As a Product Analyst at Liftoff, you'll turn complex data into rigorous analysis that informs product decisions across our machine learning-powered platform. You'll own the analytical needs of your product team end to end: identifying the right questions, executing the analysis, and presenting results that shape what gets built. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Machine Learning Engineers to define success metrics, evaluate experiments, and understand the drivers of user behavior and advertising performance.

Responsibilities:

  • Source, scope, execute, and present analyses for your product team, working independently from question to recommendation.
  • Partner with Product Managers and ML teams to define and monitor key success metrics for product features.
  • Design, analyze, and interpret A/B tests and other experiments with statistical rigor.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that enable transparent, self-service monitoring of product performance.
  • Develop reusable SQL, analytical notebooks, and lightweight frameworks, including LLM-assisted workflows, to streamline recurring analyses.
  • Investigate unexpected changes in product or business performance and clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
  • Build a strong working knowledge of Liftoff's core data tables, your product area, and the wider product suite.
  • Collaborate with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to ensure data quality, metric consistency, and reliable instrumentation.
  • Document analytical approaches, assumptions, and methodologies to support reproducibility.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements: 

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics 
  • Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python for data analysis.
  • Experience delivering analytical projects independently, from scoping through to presentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar).
  • Degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Location:

This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities in the Pacific Time Zone: California, Nevada, Oregon, and Washington (State).

We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation:
Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.

fraud and AML capability exists to keep us safe. We believe a meaningful share

You will own risk, fraud and compliance as a product line — not as a cost

centre. You are being hired to design, build and ship products that reduce loss,

chargeback and dispute tooling they will pay for, underwriting and KYB

between a compliance officer, a backend engineer and a merchant, and you will be

jobs.title: 1st Product Manager
jobs.desc:
The company

Ooak Data turns company data into training data for AI agents.

Frontier labs can train models to reason. They cannot train them to work: navigating a real company's Slack threads, half-finished Notion docs, contradictory Jira tickets, and permission boundaries. That requires real enterprise data, and you cannot synthesize it. You have to source it.

We plug into enterprise tools, anonymize everything into a structurally identical digital twin, and generate reinforcement-learning environments with expert-level tasks calibrated against frontier models.

We are a Y Combinator company with 7 figures signed contracts with three frontier AI labs, and we are scaling delivery aggressively over the next twelve months. Three founders, full-time since December 2025: Pierre-Louis (CEO, ex-COO in edtech, sold data to frontier labs), Grégoire (CPO, first PM & head of Ops at Epsor through Series B), Thomas (CTO, ex-Head of Data at PayLead, ex-Samsung AI lab).

Why this role exists

Our engineering team ships faster than founders can specify. We have four product surfaces, most of them internal, all of them technical, and every one of them decides whether an environment ships this week or next.

We are hiring our first Product Manager to own the product: what gets built, in what order, and whether it actually made us faster.

What you will own

The full chain, from the moment a CEO agrees to share their data to the moment a frontier lab receives an environment.

Partner experience

  • The Data Hub, onboarding and export tutorials a CEO sees when they hand us their company's history. Trust and speed at the top of the funnel.

The data pipeline

  • Connectors, ingestion and anonymisation. How raw Slack, Drive, mail and CRM exports become a clean digital twin. You will spend a lot of time with Thomas (CTO) here.

Pharos, our delivery platform

  • The internal tool our Ops team lives in to run QA and delivery. Throughput is the metric. This is where 3 env a week becomes 10.

RL environments

  • The thing the labs buy. Task design, calibration, what separates a dataset from a real agent training ground.

You will run two kinds of work at once: short projects that need tight coordination across Tech, Ops and GTM this week, and long ones where nothing exists yet and you get to decide what should.

Who you are

  • A doer. You know the product methodologies and you use them when they help, not by the book. Your instinct when something is slow is to fix it, not to schedule a workshop about it.
  • AI-pilled. You vibe code. You prototype before you write a spec. You design your own mockups. You are curious about how the models themselves are built and trained.
  • UX taste, ROI brain. Our workflows have to be brutally efficient. You judge a piece of software or a workflow by efficient it allows us to be or what value it brings to our customers.
  • You keep pace. Our engineers ship a lot. You turn that into something coherent rather than slowing it down.
  • 7+ years in product, at least some of it technical: data, infra, ML, developer tools or ops platforms. Founders and first PMs who built the function from nothing are very welcome.
  • Fluent French and English. Our customers are American, our data partners spread worldwide, our team speaks both.
  • Based in Paris.

The extra that make the difference

  • A research streak: you read papers, you have opinions on RL, you have trained or fine-tuned something.

Terms

  • Compensation: €70-90k + bonus, and 0.2% to 0.5%

**Product Manager Role**

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery and requirements definition through development, launch, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and maintain product roadmaps aligned with customer needs, business objectives, market opportunities, and company strategy.

* Translate customer and business requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and functional specifications.
* Prioritize product features and initiatives based on customer impact, business value, technical feasibility, effort, risk, and strategic alignment.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, sales, customer success, and operations teams to deliver high-quality product experiences.
* Lead product discovery activities, including customer interviews, competitive research, market analysis, user research, and hypothesis validation.
* Define product requirements and provide engineering and design teams with sufficient context to make effective implementation decisions.
* Manage and continuously refine the product backlog while maintaining clear priorities for engineering teams.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, product demonstrations, retrospectives, and release planning.

* Partner with analytics teams to develop dashboards and reporting required for product decision-making.

* Monitor customer feedback, support requests, product usage, and market developments to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate product launches with engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, support, and other relevant teams.
* Communicate product strategy, roadmap priorities, release plans, risks, dependencies, and results to stakeholders.
* Maintain product documentation, including requirements, user stories, release documentation, decision records, and product specifications.
* Identify product risks and dependencies early and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve blockers.

* Maintain awareness of competitors, emerging technologies, industry trends, and changing customer expectations.
* Take ownership of product outcomes rather than limiting responsibility to feature delivery.

jobs.title: Propulsion Product Owner
jobs.desc:
**The role**

Allocortech does not need a backlog janitor. We need someone who understands why four-quadrant FOC, voltage class, SWaP-C, and certification timeline are the product — and can turn that into a roadmap OEMs will buy.

Taurus motor controllers, Clio power/comms hubs, and the surrounding battery/PDU work already power eVTOL, hybrid cargo aircraft, and electric hydrofoils. Your job is to productize that stack.

**What you will do**

* Own the propulsion backlog: Taurus variants, voltage/power SKUs, firmware feature flags, packaging, accessories.
* Sit with EE, FOC firmware, and customers and turn “400 V, regen, eight-week MOTS” into sequenced work.
* Write requirements hardware and firmware can actually build. Kill nice-to-haves that blow SWaP or schedule.
* Partner with sales on positioning, spec sheets, and which custom asks become catalog.
* Keep the 18-month versus 24-month product bets honest.

  

**What you bring**

* 5+ years owning a technical product on power electronics, motor drives, avionics, or vehicle propulsion.
* Enough EE/firmware literacy to argue current loops, isolation, and CAN without hiding behind Jira.
* Comfort in front of aerospace, defense, or advanced-vehicle OEMs.
* Judgment on COTS vs. MOTS vs. custom — and the discipline to say no.
* Bonus: eVTOL/UAS, hybrid-electric, or maritime electric programs.

  

**Why Allocortech**

Fifty-plus people, revenue already tripled, and a propulsion line that is on vehicles instead of slides. You will set what gets built next — not write tickets for a platform team in another time zone.

***APPLY NOW***

  

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production and lab areas.

  

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package. Employees may receive equity opportunities and/or cash bonus, and have access to a robust benefits package including: top tier medical HMO, PPO & a 100% company-sponsored HSA plan option, dental and vision coverage, unlimited PTO, 11 paid holidays per year, flexible spending and dependent care savings accounts, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and access to a 401(k) retirement plan with company match. Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status; please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

jobs.desc:
### **ABOUT OUR COMPANY:**

The crushing weight of debt is something that we believe holds people back from reaching their dreams and making a splash in the world. So in 2013, after seeing our friends and family struggle with student loans, we created Splash Financial.

Over the years, our mission has expanded to include helping people with other forms of debt - such as refinancing credit cards, which are at all time highs in the US. And we've been able to refinance $6+ Billion in loans through our network of Splash, powered credit union and bank partners who leverage our marketplace and automated loan processing technology. And we've raised over $135 million from investors like partners of DST Global, Citi Ventures, TruStage Ventures, Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners, and more.

But at our core, we're still that little company from Cleveland with a big dream: to make people more powerful than their debt and we're just getting started..

### **ABOUT OUR WORKPLACE:**

Splash is remote-first, and proud of it — though our collections team works in-person at our Arizona location.

We spend our days simplifying financial products and getting them into the hands of people who need them most. Right now, we're focused on building financial technologies that fundamentally transform how the industry lends.

Although Splash has been around since 2013, we still operate like a startup — fast-paced, nimble, and full of heart. We're good people who care deeply about doing meaningful work and we approach challenges with creativity, passion, and urgency.

And to hire the best, we provide the best: great health insurance, competitive salaries, and unique benefits like quarterly meet-ups and access to engagement tools that keep us connected — even from afar.

At Splash, everything we do is guided by our values:

**Own It** – We take full accountability and follow through on commitments.

**Raise the Bar** – We move fast, innovate faster, and push through barriers.

**Say the Hard Thing** – We speak up with honesty, respect, and a desire to solve problems and make things better.

**Elevate Each Other** – We win as a team by lifting each other up.

These values show up in how we work and how we connect — whether we're collaborating on big projects or bonding over everyday moments. Yes, we even have Slack channels for #kids-and-pets and #food because we believe being human makes us better teammates.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
-------------------

Splash Financial is seeking a Product Manager to own the borrower servicing experience. You'll report to the Senior PM for Servicing, focused on building great customer experiences that directly impact how thousands of borrowers manage, repay, and interact with their loans. You'll also play a key role in improving the operational processes and partner onboarding that sit behind those experiences.

This isn't a support role. You'll own your domains end to end: running discovery, writing requirements, partnering with engineering, design, and business stakeholders, and using data to make better decisions faster.

* Own the discovery and delivery of borrower-facing servicing features, with a focus on intuitive experiences that make it easy for borrowers to manage, repay, and stay on track with their loans.

* Drive initiatives that reduce delinquency and improve payment behavior, including self-service improvements, payment plan optimization, and enrollment experiences.

jobs.desc:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal or The Netherlands

About the team

Product Operations sits at the center of how our Product and wider R&D teams work. We help create the systems, practices, and connections that allow teams to focus on solving the right problems and delivering great products.

AI is becoming an increasingly important part of that work. Across R&D, teams are already experimenting with tools like Glean and Claude, building automations, testing agents, and finding new ways to use AI throughout the product development lifecycle.

The opportunity now is to turn that energy into something more systematic.That's where you come in.

About the role

We're looking for an AI Product Operations Lead to build and operate the internal AI Operations capability for R&D.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can take an ambiguous opportunity and turn it into a reliable, adopted solution. You'll help us identify the highest-value problems AI can solve, understand how people work today, design the right solution, build or coordinate its delivery, and then stay accountable for how it performs after launch.

One day, you might be working with a team to understand a frustrating workflow and deciding whether a simple prompt, automation, integration, agent, or internal app is the right answer. The next, you could be improving an existing AI workflow, testing its reliability, helping coordinate access to an enterprise AI tool, or working with IT and InfoSec to make sure a new solution can scale responsibly.

You'll own the connective layer between AI strategy and day-to-day execution across R&D.

This isn't a role for someone who only wants to prototype prompts, manage project plans, or write requirements. We're looking for someone who enjoys combining systems thinking, AI fluency, user discovery, technical execution, and operational ownership—and who wants to see things through.

You'll report to our VP of Product Operations and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science, IT, InfoSec, and other AI practitioners across Typeform.

What you'll do

  • Build and continuously improve our backlog of AI opportunities across R&D, helping teams identify, prioritize, and sequence the jobs where AI can have the greatest impact.

jobs.title: Digital Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**The Opportunity**

Caraway’s Digital Product team is responsible for delivering a best-in-class e-commerce experience. We’re looking for a Digital Product Manager to own our onsite experimentation program and drive product improvements that increase conversion and generate incremental revenue, from identifying opportunities through testing and shipping improvements.

Reporting to the Director of Digital Product, you’ll shape the customer experience across product detail pages (PDPs), cart, checkout, homepage, landing pages, and PLPs. You’ll partner with Engineering, UX, Creative, Growth, Merchandising, Analytics, CX, and Product Marketing, combining clear product judgment with hands-on technical skills and disciplined measurement.

**Responsibilities**

Product Strategy & Prioritization

* Translate product direction into requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, success measures, and sequenced delivery plans.
* Own the site experimentation roadmap, using funnel analysis, customer feedback, and behavioral insights to identify opportunities to improve conversion.
* Manage Digital Product intake across stakeholder requests, bugs, launch needs, optimization ideas, technical debt, and roadmap opportunities.
* Own backlog grooming, sprint planning, delivery follow-up, release readiness, and post-launch reviews for assigned workstreams.

Experimentation & Technical Execution

* Partner with Engineering and Design to assess feasibility, sequence work, manage tradeoffs, and resolve delivery blockers.
* Manage delivery from scoping through launch, balancing experiments with conversion-critical bugs and site improvements.
* Own QA across variants, devices, responsive layouts, cart and checkout behavior, and tracking. Partner with Engineering on feasibility, performance, release readiness, and rollback plans.
* Use HTML, CSS, and browser developer tools to inspect onsite experiences, troubleshoot issues, and make targeted changes within approved tools.
* Turn results into decisions to ship, iterate, or stop; coordinate permanent implementation and post-launch validation, keeping partners aligned on tradeoffs and next steps.

Onsite Personalization & Segmentation

* Own and expand onsite personalization and segmentation logic, including new versus returning visitors and traffic source.
* Partner with Growth, Merchandising, Creative, and UX on audience-specific content and experiences, with clear targeting rules, exclusions, and fallback behavior.
* Validate targeting and measure incremental impact through controlled testing where feasible.

Measurement & Reporting

* Partner with Analytics and Growth to establish trusted metric definitions, tracking, funnels, and dashboards before launch.
* Define sample size, test duration, success criteria, and guardrails for experiments. Apply sound statistical judgment and account for overlapping tests, promotions, and data-quality issues to prevent false positives.
* Deliver a monthly readout connecting experiment outcomes to estimated incremental revenue, including assumptions, uncertainty, rollout status, and learnings.
* Distinguish observed results from projected impact, avoid double-counting gains, and use post-launch performance to inform future product decisions.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customer insights and business priorities translate into a focused roadmap and clear product decisions.
* Shipped improvements increase conversion while respecting AOV and RPV guardrails, with revenue impact measured and communicated.
* Experiments and features launch with strong QA, reliable tracking, and clear ownership.
* Results and learnings inform future work, including when to stop or change direction.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Job Context**

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial Product Manager who is excited about building and delivering AI-powered products that create real business impact. This role goes beyond traditional product management: you will own not only the roadmap, but also the outcomes. You’ll work at the intersection of AI capabilities, customer needs, and business strategy to deliver products that meaningfully improve how our customers operate.  
The ideal candidate is deeply curious about AI, enthusiastic about applying it to real-world problems, and motivated by measurable results. You should be comfortable moving between strategy and execution, and energized by building in a fast-moving environment.

**What You’ll Do**

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from concept to launch to iteration.
* Define and execute the product roadmap aligned with company strategy and business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities where AI can create meaningful value for customers and translate them into product initiatives.
* Use experimentation, metrics, and customer feedback to guide product decisions and continuously improve outcomes.
* Champion the use of AI both within the product and internally across workflows.
* Define clear success metrics and be accountable for product performance, adoption, and business impact.
* Engage directly with customers to deeply understand their workflows, problems, and opportunities for AI-driven improvements.
* Move quickly from idea to prototype to production, balancing speed with quality.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong interest in AI technologies and their real-world applications.
* Entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable with ambiguity and motivated to build from scratch.
* Track record of owning outcomes, not just delivering features.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong analytical thinking and ability to make data-informed decisions.
* Passion for learning, experimenting, and pushing the boundaries of what AI can do.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working with AI assisted coding (Claude Code, Cursor etc).
* Background in startups or early-stage product environments.
* Experience shipping AI-enabled features or products.

**Why Join Us**

* Build products at the forefront of AI innovation.
* Work with a highly collaborative and ambitious team.
* Have real ownership and influence over product direction and business outcomes.
* Move fast, experiment often, and see your ideas come to life.

If you’re excited about using AI to solve meaningful problems and want to take ownership of building products that drive real outcomes, we’d love to talk.

**Our Core Values**

**We Are One Team**

**We Are Customer Centric**  
**We Are Growth Minded**  
**We Are Accountable**  
**We Celebrate Success**  
  
Simpro, AroFlo, BigChange & ClockShark are equal opportunity employers with a best-of-class onboarding program and supportive team environments. This means that we want everyone to feel welcome with us and to provide equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation, or any other non-performance factor.

If you'd like to join a fun and progressive organization, where there are opportunities to develop your career, please apply now with your CV/resume.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Delivery & Experience
jobs.desc:
The Manager, Product Delivery and Experience transforms strategy into delivered outcomes by driving disciplined, high-velocity execution across the pharmacy SaaS product portfolio. This player-coach role leads the activities that position each sprint and release for success, including coordinating product ownership, shaping user stories and sprint plans, and managing Business Systems Analysts and Product Experience Designers responsible for requirements definition and user experience design. Operating at the intersection of product management, design, and engineering, this role plays a critical part in advancing innovative pharmacy technology solutions and delivering exceptional product experiences.

This is a hybrid role based in Minneapolis, MN.

**What the Manager, Product Delivery & Experience Does Each Day:**

* Hold ultimate accountability for planning and preparing work leading up through the start of each sprint based on the strategy and roadmap defined by the Director of Product Strategy
* Serve as Product Owner  
  o Partner with the Director of Product Strategy to ensure sprint plans and delivered products align with the strategic roadmap  
  o Break strategic product themes into features and features into stories; maintain User Story Maps to sequence work and illustrate dependencies  
  o Scope 6-week releases and 2-week sprints, assigning data science, development, and QA resources  
  o Coordinate and chair “product squads” – multi-disciplinary story-grooming teams  
  o Coordinate and chair Agile ceremonies leading up through the start of each sprint including effort estimations, release and sprint scoping, story kick-off discussions, etc.  
  o Collect and track metrics and KPIs on team and process performance during each release and sprint  
  o Escalate delivery risks to management
* Manage and support the business systems analysts and product experience/UX designers who prepare work for each sprint. As a player-coach, you may also contribute directly by:  
  o Use AI to rapidly prototype product ideas and designs  
  o Gather and write feature- and story-level requirements  
  o Contribute to UX, wireframe, and mockup ideas  
  o Partner with Data Science and other teams to answer data questions that might affect requirements or designs  
  o Coordinate usability studies
* Maintain security, confidentiality, and privacy of the company, its customers, investors, and partners

**Our Most Successful Manager, Product Delivery & Experience has / is:**

* Ability to rally cross‑functional teams — both direct reports and partners — around a fast‑paced yet sustainable delivery cadence
* Practical experience using AI responsibly to accelerate work, paired with a clear understanding of its limitations
* Demonstrated ability to build and implement processes, project frameworks, and operational structure
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams in fast-moving environments
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and confidently
* Customer-centric mindset with a passion for helping clients achieve meaningful value through the use of our products
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining clarity and accountability
* Ability to think at both strategic and tactical levels of detail
* Analytic mindset with the ability to track and measure program performance and outcomes

jobs.desc:
**Location:** Camas, WA / Hybrid  
**Department:** Product  
**Reports To:** Founder & CEO / Executive Leadership

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Compensation:** Competitive salary based on experience  
**Benefits:** Healthcare benefits and a company-sponsored 401(k) retirement plan

**About Synkwise**

Synkwise is a rapidly growing healthcare SaaS company dedicated to improving how residential long-term care providers operate and deliver care. Our platform helps adult family homes, assisted living communities, memory care providers, and other residential care organizations simplify daily operations, strengthen compliance, reduce administrative burden, and improve care quality.

We are building a mission-driven company grounded in integrity, innovation, accountability, thoughtful product design, and exceptional customer experience.

As Synkwise continues to grow nationally and expand our platform’s capabilities, we are looking for an experienced product leader to help us accelerate our offering.

**About the Opportunity**

Synkwise is hiring a full-time Senior Product Manager to help shape and guide the continued evolution of our platform. This is a highly cross-functional and hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between product strategy, customer needs, UI/UX, business requirements, technical specs, and engineering execution.

We are looking for a strong product thinker and operator who can understand a real-world problem, translate the solution into clear requirements, and work closely with design and engineering to carry it through release.

The right candidate will understand that great product management starts with understanding the user, use case, and underlying problem, not simply implementing feature requests.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead product initiatives from early discovery through design, development, testing, and release
* Keep Jira fully functioning and moving…enough said
* Turn complex customer and business problems into clear epics, workflows, and actionable requirements
* Understand who we’re building for and keep their real-world needs at the center of product decisions
* Partner closely with design and engineering to create intuitive, consistent, and scalable product experiences
* Spot unclear requirements, unnecessary complexity, and potential usability issues before they reach development
* Bring structure and momentum to backlog refinement, sprint planning, product reviews, and retrospectives
* Gather insights from customers and teams across Customer Success, Sales, Clinical, Compliance, and Engineering
* Evaluate opportunities based on customer impact, feasibility, and long-term strategic value
* Create practical SOPs and product documentation that people can actually understand and use
* Write clear, customer-friendly release notes that explain what changed and why it matters

**Building Products for What’s Next**

We believe AI is changing how great products are imagined, tested, and built. We’re looking for someone who is excited to help us take advantage of that shift.

You’ll use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Figma, Jira, GitHub, and AI-assisted prototyping platforms to explore ideas, sharpen requirements, accelerate research, and collaborate more effectively with design and engineering.

You don’t need to be an expert in every tool. You do need to be curious and willing to experiment with better ways of working.

Most importantly, we believe AI should strengthen human judgment, not replace it. Great product development still begins with understanding customers, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, and knowing which problems are truly worth solving.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Kinsman
jobs.desc:
**About SignalQuest**

SignalQuest is a successful, privately held technology company based in Lebanon, New Hampshire. For more than two decades, SignalQuest has designed and manufactured rugged sensors used in demanding environments across industries including heavy equipment, industrial systems, and machine control. Our sensors are trusted by major OEMs and leading machine control companies worldwide. All engineering and manufacturing are performed onsite in Lebanon.

The company is launching a new brand and product line, Kinsman (kinsmanpro.com), to sell GPS jobsite measurement systems to small business earthwork contractors. This is a major market opportunity, and SignalQuest is building the team to make it happen.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for an outstanding **Product Manager** to help build and scale the Kinsman SitePoint product line.

SitePoint combines precision GNSS RTK and INS technology, rugged hardware, and an intuitive mobile application to help earthwork contractors measure, lay out, grade, and complete jobs more efficiently. Our goal is to make sophisticated positioning technology useful to contractors who may never have used GPS or traditional machine-control systems before.

This is a highly hands-on product role. You will work directly with customers, engineers, designers, sales, and company leadership to identify important customer problems, define effective solutions, and drive those solutions from concept through release and iteration.

The ideal candidate combines **exceptional customer instincts with analytical and technical depth**. You should be equally comfortable talking with an excavator operator on a jobsite, thinking through the accuracy requirements of a measurement workflow, writing a detailed product specification, and project managing features to success.

You will report directly to the **President of Kinsman** and will have significant responsibility for shaping both the product and the way the Kinsman team builds it.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer & Product Discovery**

* Develop a deep understanding of Kinsman customers, their workflows, tools, frustrations, and business priorities
* Spend significant time talking directly with customers and observing how they work in real-world jobsite environments
* Identify important customer problems and distinguish meaningful product opportunities from isolated feature requests
* Develop strong intuition for what makes a product simple, useful, and valuable to small earthwork contractors
* Translate customer feedback, support issues, usage data, and field observations into clear product insights
* Validate new concepts and workflows with customers before and after development
* Maintain a strong understanding of competing products, industry workflows, and relevant technology

**Product Definition**

* Define clear product requirements for new features, workflows, and product improvements
* Translate complex technical capabilities into simple user experiences
* Develop detailed specifications, workflows, diagrams, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that engineering and design teams can execute against
* Think carefully about usability, accuracy, reliability, safety, and real-world operating conditions
* Work through product details before development while remaining flexible as new information emerges
* Make thoughtful tradeoffs between customer value, simplicity, technical complexity, development effort, and speed
* Ensure product decisions remain consistent with the broader Kinsman product vision and target customer

**Product Development & Execution**

* Own product initiatives from initial customer problem through definition, design, development, testing, launch, and iteration
* Work closely with software, firmware, hardware, mechanical, and design teams throughout the development process
* Maintain clear priorities and ensure the team understands what is being built, why it matters, and what constitutes a successful result

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Inkitt is building the Disney of the 21st Century, standing at the forefront of technology and entertainment. Leveraging AI and predictive algorithms, Inkitt discovers unknown stories and turns them into blockbuster hits, producing a new $1M ebook every 7 days and selling directly to consumers through its Inkitt Galatea app. Bestsellers are then translated onto the screen through Inkitt CandyJar, the #1 US-based microdrama platform with billions of episodes streamed to date. Inkitt has become the 11th most bestseller-generating publisher in the world, boasting a 40x higher hit-rate than traditional publishers. Backed by some of the top VC’s such as: Khosla, Kleiner Perkins, and NEA Ventures, our recent expansion into Ironblood, the first AI Native streaming platform for action and adventure, is only the beginning of our journey to becoming the next-gen entertainment powerhouse.

  

**Which product you'll own**

We run four consumer products and we are hiring product managers for all of them.

* **Galatea** — serialized fiction, millions of readers, coins and subscription
* **CandyJar** — the #1 US-based microdrama platform, billions of episodes streamed
* **Ironblood** — our new AI-native streaming platform for action and adventure
* **Inkitt** — the writing and discovery platform underneath all of it, where the stories come from

**We decide which one you own at the point you start, not at the point you apply.** When you join, we look at where the largest metric gap is across the portfolio and put you there. As the team grows, areas get reshuffled — people move to where the biggest problem is.

We are telling you this up front because it is a real feature of working here, and because it does not suit everyone. If you want to own one named surface for three years, this is the wrong company. Some of our strongest product managers were hired for one thing and were doing something else entirely within a year — including one who was brought in to build internal tooling and ended up launching CandyJar from zero.

  

**How We Work — please read this part carefully**

This role works differently from most product jobs, and the difference matters more than anything else on this page.

Ali, our founder and CEO, sets company priorities. **You own the ideas.** You will own an app or area end to end, and you will spend part of every day researching competitors, the industry and our users to generate new feature ideas. Every product manager here keeps a live Top 3 list of the highest-impact ideas for their area — a new idea only enters that list by beating one already on it.

You pitch ideas to Ali on a single slide with a rough impact calculation attached. He rejects the ones that will not move the number enough to justify building them. That happens often, to everyone, and it is not a signal that anything has gone wrong.

Once an idea is approved, you own execution: spec, design, engineering, launch, and the A/B test. You release and ramp tests on your own judgement. **Four weeks after launch, every feature is reviewed against the impact you predicted before you built it.**

Your performance is measured on exactly two things: how often you beat your own Top 3, and the realised impact of what you ship.

If that sounds like the job you want, the rest of this page is for you.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Own an app or area end to end — the roadmap, the backlog, the revenue and retention of it
* Generate the ideas. Research competitors, the market and our users daily, and keep a ranked Top 3 that you are constantly trying to beat
* Build the impact case before you build the feature: size the opportunity, show the maths, defend the number
* Pitch to Ali, take the rejection, sharpen it, come back
* Drive approved work through spec, design, engineering, QA and launch
* Design and run A/B tests, ramp them responsibly, and read the results honestly — including when you lost
* Publish what you learn, wins and losses alike, to the whole company
*

business, technology, and customer experience, you will be responsible for managing data

products that support our insurance services and operations. You will lead the strategy,

execution, and delivery of data solutions, leveraging insights to improve decision-making,

enhance operational efficiency, and provide value to our customers.

In this role, you will own and advance a portfolio may include multiple advanced vision integration projects. You will work at the intersection of manufacturing, quality, software engineering, machine learning, controls, and plant operations to turn complex production challenges into scalable digital products.

Your success will help manufacturing teams improve first-time-through quality, reduce scrap, strengthen defect containment, and prevent quality issues from reaching customers.

This is an opportunity to shape products that directly influence manufacturing quality, production performance, and customer protection. You will have meaningful ownership of the roadmap while working closely with the teams that design, deploy, operate, and depend on these systems every day.

**What You'll Do**
